Name: Abvion
Description:
Abvion is an early-stage biotechnology company on a mission to pioneer therapeutics based on the most powerful human antibodies.

Our proprietary AbDirect platform enables protein-centric antibody discovery, directly from human biofluids. It allows for the identification of exceptional antibodies from the blood of patients and recovered individuals, proving superior starting points for therapeutics. Inspired by nature, we aim to redefine standards of care, improve patient lives, and create a healthier tomorrow.

For more information, please visit https://www.abvion.bio or email us at contact@abvion.bio.

Name: BlinkLab Limited (ASX:BB1)
Description: BlinkLab Limited (ASX.BB1), a company founded by neuroscientists at Princeton University, over the past several years has fully developed a smartphone based diagnostic platform for autism, ADHD, schizophrenia, and other neurodevelopmental conditions. Our most advanced product is an autism diagnostic test that leverages the power of smartphones, AI and machine learning to deliver screening tests specifically designed for children as young as 18 months old. This marks a significant advancement, considering traditional diagnoses typically occur around five years of age, often missing the crucial early window for effective intervention. BlinkLab is led by an experienced management team and directors with a proven track record in building companies and vast knowledge in digital healthcare, computer vision, AI and machine learning. Our Scientific Advisory Board consists of leading experts in the field of autism and brain development allowing us to bridge most advanced technological innovations with groundbreaking scientific research.

Name: Hybridize Therapeutics
Description:
Hybridize's mission is to help patients overcome untreated kidney diseases. We do this by developing RNA-based therapies. 

Currently, we are nearing Phase 1 clinical trials (together with our partner AiCuris Anti-Infectives) for our therapy against BK-virus.

Name: AlgaSpring
Description:
Introduction
NannoStar and NutriSpring are a premium quality micro-algae products for producers and end users in aquaculture and human nutrition.
 
NannoStar and NutriSpring are 100% Dutch quality microalgae products and produced in a pristine location at the banks of the IJsselmeer at the edge of the largest protected natural area of the Netherlands. Our microalgae are grown on ancient borehole seawater (Pleistocene 130.000 years old) which is free of contamination and heavy metals.  The water is extracted from 80 meters below the surface.
NannoStar and NutriSpring are year round produced in a full controlled photobioreactor system by our dedicated team of PhD microbiologists who have 20 years of combined experience in microalgae production. The microalgae are grown on selected food grade nutrients under ISO22000 and GMP+ certification. 

Natural and sustainable
The AlgaSpring team developed an advanced algae production system which enables the production of premium quality marine microalgae at a competitive cost level. 
AlgaSpring micro algae are produced environmentally friendly and no pesticides or herbicides are used. We use selected, natural algal strains and pure water and nutrient sources. Production batches are continuously monitored for quality control.
AlgaSpring microalgae are cultivated in a mono-specific culture under controlled conditions in a semi-continuous process with optimum provision of nutrients, CO2, light and mixing. Cultivation and processing conditions are standardized which ensures a constant quality and a high content of valuable components in the microalgae product.
AlgaSpring microalgae are produced with just daylight and no additional heating other than to keep the production facility frost free during the winter. Our marine climate zone with cool summers and mild winters ensures us of year round production at the best quality.

Name: Foamlab B.V.
Description: Foamlab is on a mission to replace fossil-based plastics with premium, high-performance foams made from bacterial cellulose. Rooted in microbiology and material science, we develop bio-based foam materials with tunable properties - engineered not just to be more sustainable, but to outperform. From insulation and high-end packaging to textiles and product cushioning, we collaborate with forward-thinking companies to bring next-generation sustainable materials from lab to market.

Name: Algae Capital
Description:
Empowering life through the boundless potential of nature’s origin.

Algae Capital specializes in the large-scale and sustainable production of microalgae. We produce plant-based omega-3-rich oil and proteins for various applications.

After more than a decade of extensive research programs at our testing facility in Iceland, we are now ready for commercial production of high-quality algae products. Our first production facility is being constructed in Iceland. Production and processing is scheduled for 2025.

Algae Capital contains four subsidiaries that closely work together to manage all aspects from planning and development to production and sales. Algae Capital serves as connector, coordinating the overall activities of these entities.

Algae Capital • Algae Biotech • Algae Projects • Algae Growth • Algae Nutrition

Name: Lumox
Description:
Selective PhotoTherapy. Potent cancer drugs. Activated only where needed. Imagine activating cancer drugs only where needed.
We’re developing a therapy that targets tumors with unmatched precision, sparing healthy tissue.
For patients who now face disfiguring surgery — or have no treatment options at all.

Name: Tear Research Network
Description: The Tear Research Network (TRN), launched in May 2022, aims to bring together clinicians, scientists, and researchers around the world that are involved in tear fluid research, education, and development.

Name: Biomod AI (Techstars '24)
Description: Biomod AI was a natural language platform for molecular biology education. Students used it during university practicals to learn in silico design workflows, including oligo design, sequence retrieval, and CRISPR guide selection, through an AI-guided interface rather than manual tools. Used by several hundred students across multiple institutions.

Name: Tzu Cancer Therapeutics
Description: Tzu is an innovative biotechnology company dedicated to personalized oncology. We enhance patient survival by conducting deep molecular analysis of Circulating Tumor Cells (CTCs) isolated from blood samples. Our advanced technologies tailor therapies to the specific traits of each cancer, driving the development of next-generation treatments.

Name: Nawah Scientific International
Description:
Accelerate Your R&D with better time and cost efficiencies 
Nawah is a Dutch CRO with HQ in Amsterdam and lab facilities in 3 different Middle East countries offering full-service laboratory solutions for you here in Europe. Researchers, Pharma and biotech firms gain access to our ISO 17025-certified labs, staffed by a multidisciplinary team of scientists specialized in diverse Life Science fields. With over 10 years of operation, Nawah scientists have analyzed 1M+ samples, served clients in 30+ countries and helped researchers and young biotech startups generate more data at much less cost maintaining highest industry standards. Nawah eliminates the need for costly infrastructure while delivering trusted, end-to-end R&D support.
Why Nawah?
-	ISO 17025-Certified Excellence: Assured compliance with international standards for testing and calibration, delivering reliable, reproducible results for critical research and development.
-	Academic Rigor: A world-class team of scientists and professors with years of experience to support your research projects.  
-	Involvement: Direct access to the assigned scientists to share thoughts and discuss scientific details throughout the process.  
-	Effective communication: A dedicated account manager to facilitate your contact and interaction with Nawah’s Team.  
-	Transparency: Project raw data is available on request. 
-	Cost-effective: The fastest possible research services with reasonable cost.

Name: 20Med Therapeutics
Description:
20Med Therapeutics is a biomedical company developing innovative solutions for efficient intracellular delivery of RNA and DNA based vacccines and therapeutics. 
20Med's proprietary highly innovative nanoparticles are designed with several smart functions that make them efficient in protecting fragile payload, transport, cellular uptake, and release of active Oligonucleotide based payloads into the cytoplasm of target cells. 
20Med's nanoparticles are flexible in functionalization and their unique properties make them applicable in a broad field of medical therapeutics.

Name: TropIQ Health Sciences
Description: Accelerating the elimination of tropical infectious diseases

Name: Biocatalysts Baking
Description:
In 2023 Biocatalysts Ltd successfully completed the acquisition of Breatec, WeissBioTech and Biosun from its parent company BRAIN Biotech AG, creating the Bioproducts division under the Biocatalysts brand. 
Biocatalysts Ltd is an industry expert in the discovery, development, and manufacture of multi-speciality enzymes. 

As Biocatalysts Baking, formerly known as Breatec, we are the experts in baking enzymes and functional baking ingredients. 
With a complete portfolio designed for the milling and baking industry, we offer a spectrum of solutions, from enzymes to emulsifiers, tailored to meet your specific needs. 
Our experience in handling various baked goods and intricate baking processes empowers us seamlessly integrating small-scale bake lab tests into full-scale production. 
We take pride in our technical support,  providing customised solutions that address both your unique customer requirements and the ever-evolving trends in the baking industry. 

Our operations in Nieuwkuijk are certified under FSSC 22000 food safety management quality systems and audited accordingly on a yearly basis.

Name: Mercurna
Description:
Mercurna is a Netherlands-based biotech startup developing messenger RNA (mRNA) based medicines. To that end we are continuously perfecting our platform technology which combines unique cell-targeting ligands, with a proprietary lipid-based delivery vehicle to deliver engineered mRNA with high efficiency and high specificity to the diseased tissues. We leverage this platform in our pursuit of various life-changing medicines.

We are in particular determined to deliver first-of-its-kind precision medicines for inflammatory diseases, with a current focus on (chronic) kidney disease.

Name: Ellogon.AI
Description: ELLOGON.AI is working on personalizing immunotherapy with the power of big and rich data, cutting-edge algorithms and a world-class research and development team.

Name: InteRNA Technologies BV
Description:
In the course of 2022, InteRNA concluded the first part of its Phase 1a clinical trial with lead candidate INT-1B3 showing a positive safety profile. Unfortunately, due to lack of capital InteRNA was not able to start the second part of this trial for which the necessary regulatory approvals were in place. Despite also the already obtained clearance from the FDA for the Phase 1b/2a trial, the outlook on a combinatory trial with one of the leading PD1 inhibitors in the immune-oncology marketplace and a positive FTO analysis, InteRNA has not been able to attract further funding in the distressed financing climate and was forced to cease operations at the end of Q1-2023. 

Here we wish to extend our sincere gratitude to the participating patients and their families, as well as our employees, board members, clinical and scientific advisors, investors and partners for their support throughout our journey. 

It is a pity that INT-1B3 with its promising and unique Mode of Action did not get the chance to be validated in a clinical trial for its efficacy.

Name: ALS Investment Fund
Description: We are a Venture Capital fund that invests in biotech companies developing drugs in a specialised area of disease: neurodegeneration, with a particular focus on ALS

Name: Xenikos B.V.
Description: Xenikos is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing a novel therapy that aims to quickly and efficiently reset the immune system of patients suffering from serious immune diseases, or rejection after transplantation. The Company’s lead product candidate, T-Guard, is currently in Phase 3 development for the treatment of steroid-refractory acute graft-versus-host disease (SR-aGVHD). Based on its mechanism of action, Xenikos believes T-Guard also has the potential to be effective in treating certain other serious immune conditions, such as transplant-related rejection, solid-organ rejection and several severe autoimmune diseases.

Name: NTrans Technologies BV
Description:
Imagine a world where we conquer cancer and genetic diseases. At NTrans Technologies, we solve key challenges in cell and gene therapy: Delivering life-changing therapies to the right cells and tissues.

We leverage nature’s own mechanisms for cellular uptake to ensure efficient and safe therapeutic delivery. Welcome to the next frontier of medicine.

Our proprietary platform is GMP-ready and sets a new standard in cell and gene therapy. We use a non-viral delivery system to harness macropinocytosis - a natural cellular uptake process - for precise and secure delivery of gene-editing technologies.  


The mission of NTrans Technologies is to become the leading non-viral delivery platform in cell and gene therapy.

Please contact us at: info@ntranstechnologies.com

Name: Mycelium Materials Europe
Description:
Mycelium Materials Europe (in short MME) is a start-up active in the bio-based materials and circular economy. 

We produce sustainable mycelium materials based on mushroom technology. Mycelium is the branching underground structure of mushrooms. 

We grow these mycelium materials in our own mushroom farm from organic waste like sawdust from sawmills. Our mycelium materials are therefore bio-degradable. 

Our customers are designers, the building industry and the fashion industry.

Name: SV Biotech BV
Description:
SV Biotech B.V. supports biotech and life science teams with rapid cell platform development and in vitro testing solutions.

We specialize in the fast adaptation of commonly used mammalian cell systems (including CHO-K1, HEK293 / HEK293T, BHK-21, Vero and related lines) from adherent to suspension, helping reduce development timelines and enabling scalable, reproducible workflows for screening and production.

In parallel, we provide customized in vitro toxicity and dose-response assays, as well as test development and execution services to support early-stage decision making in product, material, and process development.

Our approach is focused on speed, flexibility, and direct execution—working closely with clients to deliver reliable results without the delays and complexity of larger CROs.

SV Biotech has developed the PlasticTox platform, one of the first commercially available solutions for measuring microplastic presence in human blood, supporting a new generation of research on human exposure and potential biological impact.

Name: Promicol Manufacturing B.V.
Description:
Save money and time while raising quality control standards by using Promicol ATP Bioluminescence technology.

Established in 2000, with many years of experience in all aspects of ATP technology. Promicol develops and manufactures innovative, rapid testing for microbial contamination of products and raw materials for the food, beverage and cosmetic markets. 

Promicol provides rapid sterility testing for vaccines, cell gene therapies and commercial injectables. For this industry we have introduced an industrial change where sterility testing time has been reduced to 48 - 72 hours instead of 14 days. 

We specialise in making ATP bioluminescence work for your products, and your company, by delivering products and services tailored to the challenges of industrial microbial control and quality management world-wide.  

Committed to high levels of customer service and support, our aim is to develop long-term working relationships with our customers built on trust, innovation and expertise as we help to provide solutions to the demands and challenges from rapidly changing markets making ATP work for you, together with you.

Promicol is against animal cruelty and is not associated with any brand that conducts animal testing. 

#FoodSafety #QualityAssurance #Biotechnology #Promicol

Name: Omnigen BV
Description:
At Omnigen, we believe that the power of biotechnology and computational biology can help us and the world around us. By harnessing the power of this exciting science, we want to work together with you and other companies to personalise health care and improve the quality of life for all who choose to take advantage of this opportunity. 

Founded in (april) 2012, Omnigen is a young and dynamic company, eager to apply skills and knowledge to the field of life sciences. Omnigen is able to assist in data analysis, developing your custom software solutions, and can provide consultancy to determine your bioinformatics possibilities or requirements.

Name: Zetamatrix
Description:
Zetamatrix was born as a start-up in 2021. Our major goal is to become a pioneer in the development of next-generation biomaterials for 3D cell culture and bioprinting applications.

The company manufactures bioinks in the form of hydrogels that act as extracellular-matrix environments to support cell growth and proliferation. The unique properties of the products allow our products to replicate the properties of specific tissues, thus allowing cells to grow and reproduce in a realistic 3D environment.

Name: HaloVerse MSCA-DN
Description:
HaloVerse is a Horizon Europe Marie Skłodowska-Curie Doctoral Network (MSCA-DN) focused on training 13 Doctoral Candidates in a synergistic inter- and multidisciplinary environment to lead Europe’s next generations towards sustainability in the highly polluting chemical process of halogenation.

HaloVerse will develop powerful enzymatic systems for selective halogenations in industrially relevant setups. Participating industries will guide innovation and will be involved in the training programme to implement fundamental aspects of technology transfer and development strategies, both career and product oriented.

This project receives funding from the European Union #HorizonEU Research and Innovation Programme (GA No. 101226357). Any related posts reflect only the views of the project owner.

Name: Organoid Center Amsterdam UMC
Description:
Organoid Center Amsterdam UMC is an organoid core facility that enables the global use of human organoids for studying human biology and tackling human diseases. 

Within the Amsterdam UMC, the Organoid Center connects experts in organoid technology, trains researchers and disseminates organoid research.

Name: MAGic-MOLFUN
Description:
The MAGic-MOLFUN doctoral network (DN) will train the next generation of specialists to transform natural products research. 

The next generation of specialists will be educated in a combination of wet-lab and computational skills to integrate genome mining and metabolomics with cutting-edge pathway discovery- and engineering approaches. There is a fast-growing demand for these combinations of skills, but these are rarely taught in current integrated training programs. These multidisciplinary skills and qualifications will be acquired while achieving the scientific goals of the program, namely understanding and developing the complex biosynthesis and production of microbial NPs for cross-sector applications such as medicine, food, agriculture, or biotechnology. Specifically, the Doctoral Candidates (DCs) will work in three areas:

    1) develop novel computational tools and algorithms to improve the identification and prediction quality of biosynthetic gene clusters encoding NP biosynthesis in genomic data. This genome-centered approach is complemented by
   2)  the use of cheminformatics approaches to link metabolomics data of NPs with the genomic data of the producers, which will greatly improve the compound discovery and dereplication process. These two data-centric approaches will finally
    3) converge into experimental applications that discover and characterize novel NPs with promising bioactivities (e.g., antibiotics, pre-/probiotics, agrichemicals, bio-pigments).

The scientific training program is complemented by a comprehensive transferable skill training that will equip the DCs for todays’ demands of a successful career in industry and academia. The skills obtained in the DN will enable the DCs to work not only in natural product research but also many other data-intensive areas of biotechnology.

“This project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon Europe programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie grant agreement No 101072485”.

Name: Sustainables
Description:
Sustainables richt zich erop om alle single-use items uit onderzoek en de gezondheidszorg te halen. Door disposables schoon te maken maken wij ze beschikbaar voor recycling met het uiteindelijke doel om ze te hergebruiken. 

Contact: info@sustainables-nijmegen.nl

Name: Human Metabolome Technologies
Description: Human Metabolome Technologies (HMT) is a Japan-headquartered biotechnology company founded in 2003 and global leader in capillary electrophoresis-mass spectrometry (CE-MS) based metabolome analysis. We established our United States headquarters in Boston, MA in 2012 and have spent the last 8 years developing solutions for a broad range of research endeavors in pharma, biotech, and food production.

Name: Protein Port
Description:
Protein Port is a dedicated expert network rooted in the Dutch biotechnology sector. We unite specialists around focused topics, aligning knowledge and interests to accelerate progress across the industry. By gathering input directly from the sector, we connect you with the right experts to develop concrete solutions. As a non-profit supported by the Province of South Holland and Innovation Quarter, we rely on your expertise, time, and commitment. Reach out to learn more and start an expert table with us.

Let’s drive the protein transition together.

info@proteinport.com

Name: CarbExplore
Description:
CarbExplore develops proprietary enzymes for the manufacture of functional carbohydrates. The core technology is based on identifying novel glucansucrase, glucantransferase, inulosucrase, and beta-galactosidase enzymes. Renewable materials such as sugar, starch and lactose are converted into high-margin carbohydrates with health and physical benefits. The alpha-glucans find their use as prebiotics with texturizing properties in foods and cosmetics. Our product portfolio consists of carbohydrate-based stevia sweeteners, anti-staling agents for baking, rheology modifiers, human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs) and galacto-and fructooligosaccharides (GOS-FOS). 

To support carbohydrate development, an extensive package of carbohydrate analysis and structure elucidation is offered. CarbExplore is looking for contact research collaborations within the fields of food, nutrition, and nutraceuticals. Our technology contributes to a sustainable and healthy society.

Name: Innoveins Seed Solutions
Description:
Innoveins Seed Solutions is the new company and new partner in research on seed technology, which focusses on performing seed technological research for the seed industry, agrochemical industry and technology suppliers. Innoveins Seed Solutions is offering research services to test seed coatings, agrochemical and biochemical seed treatments (GEP), priming, seed sorting equipment and phenotyping of seeds. Innoveins Seed solutions is a joint venture with Botany B.V. who has more than 15 years of experience in offering research services in the agricultural and horticultural industry. Innoveins Seed solution is a partner of Innoveins R&D activities.

For more Information:
info@innoveinsseedsolutions.com

Name: Uneedle
Description: Uneedle realises a proprietary microneedle platform by co-developing suprachoroidal and intradermal administered medicinal products with   biotech partners.

Name: ARTIC Technologies
Description:
ARTIC Technologies develops advanced microscale fluid control solutions inspired by nature. Our first focus is user-friendly dynamic 3D cell culture platforms, increasing reproducibility of 3D cell cultures and saving time and costs by reducing test animals in pre-clinical drug studies.

Spun out of Eindhoven University of Technology, we use Magnetic Artificial Cilia technology to move and control fluids with high precision. We believe advanced technologies can contribute to creating a world in which both people and the planet thrive. Looking ahead, we are exploring broader applications in life sciences and green tech—where accurate, contactless fluid control can make a real difference.

Name: Cell4Pharma
Description:
We envision a world without a risk for renal toxicity for compounds entering clinical stages of drug development.

Cell4Pharma aims to reduce the failure rate in late clinical stages due to renal tox below 3% market wide within the next 10 years. Without the use of animal experimentation.

This ambition is supported by our human renal cell line ciPTEC validated during extensive collaborations with the pharmaceutical industry. More than 10 years of research lead to the development of robust cell-based assays focusing on the detection of highly specific biomarkers for renal toxicity.

Name: Lemba Therapeutics
Description:
Lemba Therapeutics is a biotechnology company that unlocks the therapeutic potential of the non-coding genome. Our goal is to create a new generation of RNA medicines that target long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) to treat inflammation, cancer, metabolic disorders and autoimmune diseases. 

LncRNAs are powerful regulators of cellular function, inflammation and aging. As lncRNAs are expressed in a disease-specific manner we can target diseased tissues and spare healthy ones, which significantly reduces toxicity risk. To unlock this potential, we built a cutting-edge platform that integrates functional genomics, AI-powered target discovery and high-throughput screening to identify antisense oligonucleotides (ASOs) that target lncRNAs.  

Our scientific team brings interdisciplinary expertise in RNA biology, immunology, clinical biology, and data science, which allows us to explore a vast and largely untapped therapeutic frontier. 

We aim to unleash the power of non-coding RNA-based therapeutics and provide safe and highly targeted RNA medicines to improve patients' lives. We are guided by scientific excellence, creativity, collaboration and integrity. We foster an inclusive, purpose-driven culture where people are empowered to innovate and build solutions that matter. 

Headquartered in Nijmegen, the Netherlands, our international team spans six countries and more than 15 nationalities. Rooted in innovation, Lemba Therapeutics aims to achieve global impact in RNA-based therapeutics.

Name: Chromodynamics
Description: At Chromodynamics, we are on a mission to deliver instruments that eliminate guesswork from drug development and prescription. Our unique technology allows for an enormous improvement in speed, efficacy, and cost with which exciting new treatments like immunotherapy are developed. We have been recognised as one of the most promising startups in the Eindhoven Brainport region and are expanding our team to ramp up our product development.

Name: Siron Clinical
Description:
For 25 years, Siron Clinical has been a leading provider of flexible, high-quality CRO services across Europe, Israel, and Turkey. Founded on a commitment to advancing clinical research through expertise and regional insight, Siron Clinical supports biotech and pharmaceutical companies as they navigate the complex landscape of clinical development. From early-phase studies to multi-country late-phase trials, we specialize in guiding clients through the regulatory and operational challenges that arise in Europe’s diverse clinical environments.

Siron Clinical are trusted industry experts in complex clinical trials across diverse therapeutic areas including orphan diseases, pediatrics, and medical devices sectors.

We are focused on sharing our CRO experience and guiding medical breakthroughs that better the lives of tomorrow. Our extremely accomplished research professionals are the EU experts for global clinical challenges.

Name: BFF
Description:
Empowered by NIZO, The Biotechnology Fermentation Factory (BFF) in Ede is a state-of-the-art, public-private, open-access scale-up facility dedicated to advancing the production of foods and food ingredients through fermentation technology, including precision fermentation.

As one of the few facilities of its kind, it plays a crucial role in accelerating both national and international innovation in (precision) fermentation, bridging the gap between research and large-scale production.

Located in the foodvalley region, a thriving hub for innovative food production, the facility benefits from a well-established ecosystem of cutting-edge research institutions, pioneering food companies, and specialized infrastructure. This dynamic environment makes it the ideal place for companies looking to scale their fermentation-based food innovations, collaborate with industry leaders, and gain access to essential expertise and resources.

Name: Innatoss Laboratories
Description:
Innatoss Laboratories is a Dutch research intensive organization developing and performing in vitro diagnostics of infectious diseases such as Lyme disease, Q fever and recently COVID-19. With our lab facility located in the center of the largest Q fever epidemic worldwide, we are very aware of our goal: improve diagnostics to detect these infectious diseases as early as possible and rid the world of associated health problems, such as the chronic types of these diseases. Our passion, knowledge and drive will helps us to reach our goals and to assist those who are in need of innovative diagnostics and blood testing services.

Recent assignments and achievements include CE certification of the first cell-mediated immunity test for Q fever (Q-detect), consortium membership of a Q fever vaccine development program led by Massachusetts General Hospital and an EU Horizon 2020 grant for the development of a cellular Lyme diagnostic test. We are open to new opportunities, collaborations and existing developments to bring diagnostic tests for infectious diseases to the next level.

Name: Nova Innova
Description: A creative startup that combines nature, science and design.

Name: Temple Therapeutics
Description: A clinical-stage biotechnology company pioneering a female-focused precision medicine approach using validated biobanks for the discovery, development, and commercialization of novel therapeutics and companion diagnostics in women's health.

Name: JiTiBa Algae Technologies
Description:
JiTiBa is a Dutch cleantech startup developing a sustainable solution for the growing water-quality challenge in the Netherlands and Europe.

Our algae pearls are designed to treat wastewater by capturing nutrients such as nitrogen and phosphorus. The technology aims to complement existing treatment processes while enabling the recovery of biomass for potential applications such as biochar and biogas.

We are developing the solution for applications in wastewater treatment, agriculture and industry, with the broader objective of preventing pollution from reaching rivers and other natural water systems.

Laboratory testing and prototype systems have demonstrated nutrient uptake. We are now advancing our proof-of-concept systems and investigating the potential capture or removal of heavy metals, pharmaceutical residues, PFAS and other micropollutants.

Our ambition is to combine environmental impact with practical value for water users: cleaner water, more efficient treatment and improved compliance with increasingly stringent water-quality requirements.

JiTiBa and its founders have also received recognition through several innovation award nominations.

 Let’s work together towards cleaner and more resilient water systems.

 info@jitiba.com
 www.jitiba.com

#WaterTechnology #Cleantech #WastewaterTreatment #Microalgae #CircularEconomy #WaterInnovation #Sustainability

Name: Orgonex B.V.
Description:
Orgonex B.V. is a pioneering Dutch biotechnology company, headquartered in Utrecht, that was founded in 2023 as a spin-off of Utrecht University.
Orgonex B.V. focuses on the development, production and commercialization of a spinning bioreactor for organoid culture, the RPMotion. The RPMotion is based on breakthrough research from the internationally highly rated Faculty of Veterinary Medicine at Utrecht University. Orgonex B.V. is currently building its team and core business. We are committed to creating groundbreaking hardware solutions in the field of organoid technology by reducing the effort of the current culturing methods in a sustainable way and continue to work on innovative solutions in this area together with our strategic partners. For more information, please visit www.orgonex.com

Name: CiMaas BV
Description: Our mission is achieving a better cure for cancer. For this, CiMaas develops therapies engaging the immune system for the treatment of a steadily growing population facing cancer that cannot be cured by the current standard of care. A better cure relates to safe technology taking away several of the severe side-effects of current therapies.

Name: iGEM TU Eindhoven
Description: We are a student team from the Eindhoven University of Technology that participates yearly in the iGEM competition. This is an international student competition in the field of Synthetic Biology, with over 400 participating teams.

Name: HHV Biotech
Description: HHV Biotech is a biotechnology company that specializes in the creation and development of biofilm-focused therapeutics for the treatment of biofilm-related disorders

Name: Levels Diagnostics
Description: Levels Diagnostics is a protein biomarker discovery company that is translating its findings towards the development of novel diagnostics. Our two core programs are focused on 1) identification of early stage liver cancer 2) differentiating bacterial from viral respiratory tract infections.

Name: Plant Lighting B.V.
Description:
Research and consultancy aiming at innovation in horticulture and plant breeding. Specialist in photosynthesis and (supplemental) lighting of crops. For more info: www.PlantLighting.nl

Onderzoek en advies gericht op innovatie in de tuinbouw- en plantenveredelingsector. Specialist in fotosynthese en (bij)belichting van gewassen. Er ligt een schat aan wetenschappelijke kennis die tot dusverre onbenut blijft in de praktijk. Plant Lighting schakelt wetenschap en praktijk, en richt zich o.a. op efficiëntere productie van planten, doelgericht telen, energiebesparing en phenotyping. 

Voor meer informatie: www.PlantLighting.nl

Name: Next Generation ImmunoDermatology
Description: Next Generation ImmunoDermatology, NGID for short, exists for one reason: to advance and improve dermatology treatments across six inflammatory skin conditions. NGID is a research consortium consisting of doctors and researchers from all university medical centers in the Netherlands. They join forces with technologists and data scientists, patients, students, and industrial partners. Together we gain new insights into skin diseases and we can start developing personalized treatment.

Name: Detact Diagnostics
Description:
At Detact We Believe That Bacterial Detection Is Vital To Sustain Healthy Living. 

Preventing Bacterial Contamination Is Key.

We Produce Bacterial Detection Solutions,                                  
Reliable, Affordable, Easy And Fast.

Name: ComeInCell
Description:
EU Horizon Europe Funded Doctoral Network


COndensates at Membrane Scaffolds – INtegrated Systems as Synthetic CELL Compartments (ComeInCell)

ComeInCell is a European Doctoral Network at the forefront of synthetic cell research. Our mission is to develop advanced cellular mimics that integrate functional membrane structures and biomolecular condensates. By creating these next-generation synthetic cells, we aim to shed light on complex cellular mechanisms, particularly those involved in neurodegenerative diseases and membrane trafficking, as well as accelerate drug discovery and therapeutic innovation.

This ambitious project brings together a diverse team of experts in biophysics, nanotechnology, biochemistry, and bioengineering. Our doctoral candidates will receive interdisciplinary training, gaining hands-on experience with state-of-the-art methodologies and working closely with both academic institutions and industry partners.

Through ComeInCell, we’re not just advancing scientific knowledge – we’re cultivating a new generation of quantitative synthetic biologists equipped to tackle global challenges in biomedical research and biotechnology. Join us as we explore the fascinating interface between membranes and condensates, paving the way for novel therapeutic strategies and research tools!

ComeInCell is a European project funded by the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions. DN. It is also co-funded by UK Guarantee Scheme.

Name: Pluriomics
Description: Pluriomics is a biotech company with R&D laboratories in Leiden (the Netherlands) and production facilities in Gosselies (Belgium). The company is focused on the development of fully functional human assay systems for use in drug discovery and development. Based on our novel proprietary methods for differentiation of stem cells we develop highly functional cell types like our Pluricyte Cardiomyocytes. We use these cells in combination with phenotypic assays to deliver high quality results.

Name: Self-screen B.V.
Description:
The history of Self-screen is a track record in translational science. The company was founded in 2008 to advance the implementation of scientific discoveries in the field of cancer screening into routine practice. Our dedication is towards the development and clinical application of molecular assays for the early detection of cancer, thereby to the benefit of patients around the world.

Currently, the company’s main focus is on cervical cancer screening and prevention. The company has two clinically validated assays on the market. We strive towards all-molecular screening to ensure objectivity, reproducibility and high-throughput possibilities. Our research and development pipeline currently focuses on the extension of our science towards other sample types, like urine, and towards other cancer types.

HPV-Risk Assay
The HPV-Risk Assay is an in vitro real-time PCR-based assay
The HPV-Risk Assay is an in vitro real-time PCR-based assay for the qualitative detection of human papillomavirus (HPV) DNA, targeting the E7 region of the following 15 (probably) high-risk HPV genotypes, i.e., 16, 18, 31, 33, 35, 39, 45, 51, 52, 56, 58, 59, 66, 67, and 68.

The QIAsure Methylation Test
The QIAsure Methylation Test is a real-time PCR-based molecular assay
The QIAsure Methylation Test is a real-time PCR-based molecular assay to distinguish women with cervical (pre)cancer. The QIAsure Methylation Test specifically detects women with a cancer-like methylation profile that have a short term high risk for progression to cervical cancer.

Name: AI4b.io
Description:
The Artificial Intelligence laboratory for Bioscience (AI4b.io) is the first of its kind in Europe to apply artificial intelligence (AI) to full-scale biomanufacturing, from microbial strain development to process optimization and scheduling.

The AI4b.io Lab is part of the Dutch National Innovation Center for AI (ICAI), which works to keep the Netherlands at the forefront of knowledge and talent development in AI. It is led by Professor Marcel Reinders, Director TU Delft Bioengineering Institute. DSM-Firmenich regards bioscience as an important tool for addressing climate change and resource scarcity and optimizing the global food system so will invest €2.5 million into the laboratory over the first five years.

Name: Crossfire Oncology
Description:
Aberrant functioning of kinases is known to be an important driver in cancer. Targeting hereof has proven to be extremely successful and has already revolutionized the management of numerous types of cancer.

At Crossfire Oncology we approach kinases from three different angles: inhibitors, degraders, and degrader antibody conjugates. This tailored approach allows us to design kinase targeting drugs that aim to maximize the therapeutic benefit for cancer patients.

Name: MyMicroZoo
Description:
Neem de controle over je eigen (darm-) gezondheid  

Een divers en gebalanceerd microbioom is een gezond microbioom. Hoe jij leeft en wat jij eet, heeft daar invloed op. En we weten steeds beter hoe. Door kennis te maken met met jouw microbiota, kun je dus ontdekken wat jij specifiek kunt doen om jouw darmgezondheid te verbeteren! 

Van het verlichten van darmklachten tot het optimaliseren van je energie, of simpelweg het checken of jij inderdaad zo gezond bezig bent als jij denkt. Aan de hand van een microbioomtest kan je daar achter komen. 

We helpen jou, je cliënten én de wetenschap graag op gang. 

Benieuwd naar onze waarden, expertise, kennis over het darmmicrobioom, lopende onderzoeken, aanbiedingen en de microbioomtest? 

Neem dan vooral een kijkje op:
https://linktr.ee/mymicrozoo

Name: Laboratory of Microbiology
Description: The Laboratory of Microbiology engages in research and education focusing on fundamental and applied aspects of the diversity, physiology, ecology and evolution of microorganisms and their viruses. The fundamental knowledge we generate is used in various disciplines, including health & food, bioproducts & energy, and the natural environment & sustainability. Our work contributes to exploring the potential of nature and improve the quality of life.

Name: GreenQ
Description: GreenQ is the largest global commercial service provider in the field of cultivation and production related knowledge regarding food & flower processes. Our professionals are a strong team of enterprising, independent developers with leading knowledge and expertise to offer each client the best solutions and guiding clients to realize their ambitions. We provide services in consultancy, research (on-site or at our own greenhouse complex), trainings and (turnkey) projects to progressive parties in cultivation and cultivation environments.

Name: ToxGenSolutions BV (TGS)
Description:
ToxGenSolutions (TGS) applies toxicogenomic approaches on human health problems to provide the customer with epigenetic biomarker fingerprints for application in novel, more accurate, methods for the particular diagnosis of their need.

TGS aims to develop novel and innovative epigenetic profiles hallmarking high-impact chronic and rare neurodevelopmental diseases to serve as early, preclinical, diagnostic verdicts of a disease. 

 With the development of these novel tools, TGS aims to bridge the frequently large gap towards disease progression and therapeutic intervention. 

TGS provides novel epigenetic diagnostic methods for the early identification of pressing high-impact pathologies including cancer, neurodegeneration and immune-dysfunction, before irreversible disease-specific alterations in patient physiology have occurred. By doing this, we aim to provide an optimal perspective for patient healthcare as well as follow-up programs and preventative therapeutic interventions.

Name: StemX Bio
Description: At StemX Bio, we’re transforming drug discovery with our ready-to-use human pancreas microtissue model. Our innovative approach, backed by a patent-pending differentiation protocol, empowers researchers to rapidly advance from screening to clinical trials. Our human microtissue models offer unmatched predictive value, robustness, and scalability, accelerating the development of effective and safer therapies for diabetes. Join us in shaping the future of medical research and treatment.

Name: Aestuarium
Description: Droughts and water shortages are becoming more frequent due to climate change. Building on earlier efforts, our team has designed a novel method of water desalination to solve the ongoing challenge of water scarcity. Current desalination systems use fossil fuels, an expensive process that emits greenhouse gases. Our strategy is to create an energy-efficient solution. We accomplish this by bio-engineering bacteria to absorb salt from their surrounding liquid, on command.

Name: Dutch DNA Biotech
Description: Dutch DNA Biotech is a management buyout from TNO, which continues the R&D activities on biotechnology. TNO, the Dutch National Research and Technology Organisation, developed this world leading position in Fungal Biotechnology since the late eighties. Our company, Dutch DNA Biotech, applies and commercializes its knowhow base in several ways.

Name: S.V. LIFE
Description:
S.A. LIFE is the study association for all Life Science & Technology (LST) students at the TU Delft and Leiden University. LIFE was founded in 1999, the same year the very first students started in the LST joint degree bachelor program. Today LIFE counts around 900 members, for whom various activities are organized throughout the year. These range from career fairs and study trips to symposia and leisurely activities. LIFE aims to ensure the quality of education in the bachelor and master programs, to give LST students an opportunity to explore career opportunities, as well as to facilitate personal development through its many committees.

For more information, visit our website: www.svlife.nl

Name: Sairopa B.V.
Description: Sairopa develops novel treatments for cancer by modulating the patient’s immune system. Early 2021 Sairopa acquired, backed by a reputable biotech investor, a portfolio of therapeutic antibodies from an American public company. Sairopa will enter clinical testing of two of its lead compounds in Phase 1 clinical trials in 2022. The company is based in Rotterdam, the Netherlands but operates internationally & virtually. To advance our programs, we are looking for a project manager that wants to make a difference and has a pioneer’s mentality.

Name: WellMed BV
Description:
Immunologic a WellMed company is one of the most rapid growing companies in the Immunohistochemistry.

Immunologic was founded in 1999. Immunologic a WellMed company has successfully managed to gain a reputation through its products and service. The company focus is on IHC, which is the most sensitive, specific, and cost-effective technology for elucidating gene and protein changes in tissue and cells.

Due to the intensive back-up of its suppliers, Immunologic offers the most professional and swift services to its customers. Immunologic only works with a very select group of suppliers and manufacturers that are complementary to our own production facilities and products. This philosophy runs through the entire structure of the company in order to assure complete customer satisfaction and absolute product superiority.

Name: DELPHINIUM
Description:
DELPHINIUM is a dedicated and dynamic company, comprised of experienced professionals committed to Phase I clinical pharmacology. Our 12-bed Phase I clinic specializes in studies conducted with healthy volunteers, offering a range of services including Monitoring, Project Management, Data Management, Bioanalysis and more. 

Our mission is to deliver high-quality, tailor-made Phase I clinical research in which we prioritize efficient and direct communication between Sponsors and researchers to ensure a flexible, fast, and adaptive approach to your clinical program. We believe that the synergy of experience, commitment, and a personalized approach will result in the highest quality output for Sponsors and a safe and comfortable environment for our volunteers. 

Please contact us at info@delphiniumcro.com to discuss our services and how we can assist you in advancing your clinical trial.

Name: Allero Therapeutics BV
Description:
Allero Therapeutics is a Dutch biotech company that develops next generation immunotherapies for immune mediated disorders. Our goal is to develop novel targeted treatments that induce long-lasting antigen-specific tolerance.
Our proprietary SOMIT (Specific Oromucosal Immunotherapy) technology combines a tolerance-inducing agent with novel oral patch mediated targeted delivery of specific antigens to the oral mucosa immune privilege.

Name: Animal Health Concepts (AHC)
Description:
Animal Health Concepts (AHC) is a Dutch developer of innovative Feed Additives, pioneering the future of sustainable farming through breakthrough nano-encapsulation technology. We are helping stakeholders in the animal protein industry to reduce antibiotics and improve performance.  Unlike generic phytogenic ingredients or blends, our nano-carriers ensure precise delivery where animals need it most. With 3x better bioavailability than conventional formulations, we deliver superior results at competitive dosing levels - making sustainability profitable, not just compliant. We have proven results with log 4-8 antimicrobial reduction of pathogens in multiple animal species, up to 99% viral reduction in vitro of some viruses (rotavirus, PED virus), critical for support in outbreak challenges.
AHC products can be added to extruded or pelleted feed, or to feed and drinking water in farms, at competitive costs and interesting ROI.

Our products improve the performance of poultry, swine, shrimps and ruminants and can be applied in drinking water, feed and milk replacers.

Our manufacturing site is GMP+ and antibiotic- free certified.

Name: NestEgg Labs
Description:
NestEgg Labs is a company providing innovative lab automation tools for cell culture applications. We are developing the Ovation hardware along with software to control it remotely and sterile disposable parts. 

Ovation, our flagship product,  is a smart incubator that automates cell culture processes and cellular assays. The combination of powerful lens-free microscopy and fluid handling reduces experimental errors and time consuming activities. The system allows for a range of workflows to be reliably automated remotely using cloud-based software. Ovation is an affordable, flexible, and fully controllable laboratory automation system that ensures a smoother workflow in the lab, allowing freedom for researchers and their experiments.

Name: Ayuvant
Description: Ayuvant is a pharmaceutical company that has created an advanced delivery system to boost the effectiveness of RNA medicines. We focus on treating aggressive solid tumors by training patients' immune systems.

Name: Sure Laboratories - Trust us to be Sure
Description:
Sure Laboratories is a microbiological laboratory based in the Brainport Region Eindhoven, close to Pivot Park, Brightlands campuses, the Antwerp region and Germany.
We are dedicated to microbiological analysis to support our customers in the Life Science Industry and High-Tech Food/Agro Industry. 

It is our mission to accelerate your R&D and QC processes, using short communication lines with a high level of microbiological knowledge. All work is executed according to an ISO 13485:2016 quality system and the EU-GMP principles.

Contact us for:
Routine control of your pharma or medical device products
Cannabis Microbiology Testing
Validation of test methods according to PhEur/USP
Validation of sterilization processes according to ISO 11137-2
Challenge testing
Chemical disinfection testing of biocides and validation of your disinfection procedures
Endotoxin testing
R&D support

Name: AVIGI Therapeutics
Description: We're pioneering a new era in drug design and development with rationally designed medicines leveraging human capabilities in advanced chemistry and biotech advancements. Our approach centers around biomimicy selectively targeting central cascades that drive disease. Our lead program is in development in kidney disease and has the potential to modify disease outcomes for millions of patients.

Name: Agriom
Description:
Agriom specialises in breeding plant varieties for the production of floriculture and soft fruit crops.
Together with its partners, Agriom follows the global developments in the floriculture and fruit production sectors. Responding to changing market demands regarding product characteristics or colours involves a continuous process of development and selection.

In addition to breeding activities implemented within the joint-venture companies, Agriom conducts breeding and research activities for other propagation and/or production companies and provides them with assistance regarding their breeding operations. This assistance can range from consulting services to the complete design and implementation of a breeding project. Agriom also conducts breeding-related research.

Name: Genewity
Description: Genewity is a biotech company developing autologous cell and gene therapies.

Name: NEC Bio B.V.
Description: NEC Bio's mission is to develop groundbreaking therapies for patients around the globe through the use of advanced AI technologies.

Name: RenovaroCube
Description: RenovaroCube is a proprietary analytical tool that analyses genetics using machine learning algorithms to inform molecular breakdown of 13+ cancers. The Multi-omic design of the platform enables the use of different molecular layers such as epigenomics, transcriptomics, metabolomics, genomics alongside clinical data. RenovaroCube searches for individualbiomarkers and integrates validated panels for different cancer types in one Machine Learning Library.

Name: COZYME - COST action CA21162
NLSEV - Netherlands Society for Extracellular Vesicles
Description:
NLSEV connects Dutch researchers, clinicians, and industries who are active or interested in EVs.

Our aims are:
- to facilitate collaborations
- to promote EV science at national and European funding agencies
- to connect with relevant scientific societies
- to organize an annual one-day networking event

https://twitter.com/NLSEV_

Name: Morpho Biotech
Description:
Your Partner in Scientific Excellence

At Morpho Biotech, we are more than just a supplier; we are your dedicated knowledge partner in the dynamic world of life sciences. Our team of experienced and enthusiastic specialists is committed to empowering your research with innovative, best-in-class reagents, consumables, and instruments. We understand the complexities of your work and are here to provide tailored solutions and unwavering support, helping you to navigate challenges and accelerate your discoveries. We believe in the transformative power of science. Like the Morpho butterfly, a symbol of innovation, transformation, and unique beauty, we strive to bring groundbreaking thinking and a pioneering spirit to everything we do. This means delivering not only the highest quality products but also sharing our expertise to help you achieve your specific research goals, fast and flawlessly.

Name: BiodeCCodiNNg Doctoral Network
Description:
We are a European research project decoding novel reaction chemistries in enzymes and training Europe’s next visionaries for a sustainable future. The main goal of the BiodeCCodiNNg doctoral network is to prepare 10 brilliant young scientists on cutting-edge enzyme technology centered around N-N and C-C bond formations to tackle technology gaps and practical challenges, as well as to exploit synthetic opportunities with huge innovation potential. The network is established by world-leading experts from European academic institutions and industrial partners who will together implement the training agenda. This setting provides strong interdisciplinary co-supervision and intersectoral exposure in secondments to the doctoral candidates and bridges intersectoral and multidisciplinary boundaries across training in drug discovery, enzyme catalysis, and process development.

This project receives funding from the European Union #HorizonEU Research and Innovation Programme (GA No. 101073065). Any related posts reflect only the views of the project owner.

Name: Flindr (formerly Immagene)
Description: Flindr Therapeutics, based in Oss in the Netherlands, is a private pre-clinical biotech company developing next-generation precision oncology treatments. The Company, previously called Immagene, was spun out of the Netherlands Cancer Institute (NKI) and Oncode Institute in 2020, by founders Prof Daniel Peeper, Prof Christian Blank and Dr Maarten Ligtenberg. Flindr is actively building a pipeline of highly promising, first-in-class precision oncology therapies identified through the ImmunoGram Drug Discovery Engine. It is backed by V-Bio Ventures, Johnson & Johnson Innovation – JJDC, Inc., QBIC Fund, Flanders Future Tech Fund, Curie Capital, Oncode Oncology Bridge Fund, Swanbridge, Innovatiefonds Noord Holland, and BOM. Flindr has entered into a research collaboration with the NKI, and the VIB (Flanders Institute of Biotechnology).

Name: Cantoni Therapeutics
Description: Cantoni Therapeutics is a biopharmaceutical spinout company from the University of Leiden (NL) developing best-in-class inhibitors of a single enzyme with a dual therapeutic effect to benefit patients with metabolic syndrome.

Name: GlycoTherapeutics
Description: GlycoTherapeutics is a preclinical development company aiming to develop novel therapeutics targeting glycobiology processes in cancer.

Name: Omega Green B.V.
Description:
Omega Green is convinced that algae will significantly contribute to healthy and sustainable food and feed. Prerequisite is that the algae need to be mass-produced in a sustainable manner. With the unique growth system that Omega Green has developed, this economy of scale is now reality.

Omega Green offers complete services to the new algae production companies. We install our system as far as a working algae culturing system and we customise the system to your special needs.

You can see how it works in practice. We have a demo- algae production site in the Eemshaven, the Netherlands. You are welcome to make an appointment. Please contact us.

Our ambition is to provide the new algae producers an interesting business case, from the economical and ecological point of view.

Name: PULSE EU
Description:
PULSE is an EU-funded project advancing 3D bioprinting for space exploration and medicine.

We combine magnetic and acoustic levitation techniques to fabricate biological materials with great detail and precision. Our goal is to create realistic 3D cardiac models to study the effects of space environment and radiation on heart physiology and pathology.

Our interdisciplinary team aims to create a versatile testing ground for new knowledge and possible treatments of cardiac conditions on Earth and future long-term space missions.

The project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon Europe EIC Pathfinder programme under grant agreement number 101099346.

Views and opinions expressed are, however, those of the author(s) only and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union or the European Innovation Council. Neither the European Union nor the granting authority can be held responsible for them.

Account managed by INsociety

Name: Bioprex Medical
Description:
Bioprex is an immobilized hyperbranched biocidal coating that kills bacteria only on contact. Bacteria are attracted and squeezed to death by high electrostatic forces. Due to immobilization the coating doesn’t leach biocides and, as a result, no contamination of body fluids can take place.

info@bioprexmedical.com

Name: LinXis Biopharmaceuticals
Description:
We designed Fibrobodies. These proprietary proteins bind selectively to so-called activated myofibroblasts in any type of fibrotic tissue. 
Fibrobodies support conjugation of a wide range of payloads to create Fibrobody-drug Conjugates. We are developing a line-up of Fibrobody-drug conjugates for the diagnosis and treatment of fibrosis of the liver, kidney, lung and gut.

Name: Helmond Biotech-materials Hub B.V.
Description:
We offer tailored facilities for Life Sciences & Health Innovators. The Helmond Biotech-Materials Hub understands the precise environmental needs of emerging LSH start-ups for breakthrough research, rigorous testing, and accelerated product development. Our facilities are certified GMP class C/D and ISO 7/8. 

HBH at a glance:

Short Term Use:
HBH offers flexible rental terms empowering your capital for development of your start-up.

Technical Support:
Tenants benefit the Living Lab environment. Multiple expertise is available to help you understand Quality Management Systems, working according to critical guidelines (such as ISO 13485 and EU-GMP), method validation and Quality Control, ensuring that your product development follows the Quality by Design principles.

Customization:
On request cleanroom can be customized based on the specific needs of the LSH projects.

Name: BioSPX BV
Description:
BioSPX is focused on all equipment related to Life Sciences. Besides distributing these systems, BioSPX offers installations, maintenance, user trainings and support. BioSPX currently offers systems like, for example, absorbance & fluorescence measurements, live cell imaging, and gel documentation. Furthermore, automated washers and dispensers for microplates are part of the catalogue. These systems are used in many different research groups and companies in the Benelux.

Every day, our team works on sales, maintenance and demonstration of the various systems at BioSPX. Different product specialists, with knowledge on system performance, configurations and possible applications, give advice on setting up experiments and using the right settings. The service department ensures the correct installation of the equipment and is able to respond quickly and adequately when maintenance is required.

Name: Circle Solution
Description:
Circle Solution is an independent innovation and technology partner focused on transforming complex industrial residual streams into valuable circular resources.

We support companies where conventional recycling or process optimization approaches no longer suffice — particularly in cases involving contaminated, composite, or poorly defined material flows.

Operating at the intersection of materials, process development, industrial feasibility, and value chain innovation, Circle Solution helps organizations convert technical challenges into practical circular solutions.

Core activities include:

• Analysis and valorization of complex residual streams (fiber-based, mineral-based, and hybrid materials)

• Development of separation, conditioning, and upgrading technologies for circular reuse

• Process development, pilot-scale validation, and industrial implementation support

• Techno-economic, environmental, and industrial feasibility assessments

• Development of circular value chains by connecting recyclers, manufacturers, technology providers, and end-users

• Translation of sustainability and circularity ambitions into technically viable and commercially relevant solutions

Rather than applying standardized frameworks, each project starts with a deep technical understanding of the material and process context. Proven industrial principles are combined with targeted innovation to unlock new circular opportunities.

Circle Solution collaborates closely with industrial partners, technology suppliers, research organizations, and market stakeholders to bridge the gap between residual streams, industrial applications, and future circular value chains.

The focus is consistently on practical, implementable solutions that align technical performance, economic feasibility, and long-term sustainability objectives.

Name: InnoSIGN
Description: InnoSIGN is a biotech company that takes a biology-first approach to analyzing the relationships and interactions between signaling pathways to discern a series of disease driver events. Our proprietary platform quantifies the activity of 10+ essential disease-driving pathways by leveraging our proprietary structured ML algorithms developed over 10 years of research at Philips. We enable our partners to gain more insights and accelerate their discoveries and innovations.

Name: Seni-Preps B.V.
Description: SENI Preps BV: a Dutch biotech firm revolutionizing agriculture. Our natural peptides inhibit urease, thus controlling ammonium conversion to among others improve animal and fish health, and combat Vibrio in shrimp.

Name: BioCentic
Description:
Biology is becoming digitalized. Since the fist human genome was completed in 2001, the generation of data concerning DNA has exploded. DNA sequencing, which is the process of identifying the order of the nucleotides that make up our genes and genomes, is becoming mainstream. 
From computational biology to artificial intelligence to data science, many are applying cutting edge technologies to get to the insights that DNA promises. While the advances are notable, at the same time the data analysis makes the analysis more complex. The price of admission to DNA data science is high for non-R&D organisations, even though they can benefit greatly from it.
The mission of BioCentric is to help everyone that can use DNA data to get past the data science hurdle. BioCentric will provide the science to match the customers knowledge and use cases. BioCentric will set up the infrastructure and the tools needed to do state-of-the-art DNA analysis now only done by the big research departments. 

DNA and Genetics should be about biology and not about data. BioCentric will help you with making your research 
biocentric again.

Name: Airins Care
Description:
Airins Care vormt met een aantal internationaal wetenschappelijk technische bedrijven een coöperatie met als doel, het ontwikkelen en produceren van innovatieve oplossingen op het gebied van desinfectie en insectenbestrijding in de industriële en institutionele markt.


Loopt uw organisatie besmettingsrisico’s vanwege ongezonde bacteriën in en rond voeding, mens of dier? Of dalen de werkprestaties van uw mensen door slechte luchtkwaliteit? Ontdek dan Airins Care luchthygiëne, een innovatief systeem dat binnenruimten inclusief alle oppervlaktes nagenoeg kiemvrij maakt en preventief beschermd tegen her besmetting.

Het werkt zo verantwoord, dat het zelfs is goedgekeurd voor de gezondheidszorg, de bio- en de levensmiddelenindustrie.


Opvallendste voordelen luchthygiënesysteem:

- innovatief en uiterst effectief
- vermindert kiemgetal/KVE 60-100%
- houdt levensmiddelen 3-5 dagen langer houdbaar
- 100% natuurlijk, als enige in deze sector
- ontsmet ook waar normale desinfectie niet komt
- modulair systeem en overal inzetbaar
- veilig voor mens, dier en milieu


Airins Care heeft als basis de preventieve ultrasone vernevelingstechniek welke wordt toegepast in bestaande luchtbehandelingssystemen en in de vrije ruimte. De web-based, computergestuurde modulaire techniek in combinatie met het natuurlijke middel garandeert een optimaal duurzaam hygiëne rendement tegen de laagst mogelijke kosten. De werkzaamheid is onovertroffen.


Het Airins Care luchthygiënesysteem is een gepatenteerde, ultrasone vernevelingstechniek in combinatie met een 100% natuurlijk en veilig desinfectiemiddel. Resultaat? Hoog werkzame, biologisch verantwoorde, milieuvriendelijke luchthygiëne. Zo beschermt u dus tegen een bacteriële (her)besmetting. De zeer fijne verneveling komt daarbij zelfs op plekken waar normale desinfectie niet komt. Het systeem kan worden toegepast in ruimten waarin mensen en/of dieren aanwezig zijn.

Name: SiloLabs
Description:
SiloLabs is a decentralized health data exchange redefining how personal medical data is valued, accessed, and monetized. Bridging Web2 and Web3, we empower individuals to control and earn from their health data while enabling life sciences companies and researchers to access anonymized datasets through zero-proof encryption and smart contract infrastructure.

Built for the next generation of DeSci and DeFi, SiloLabs integrates blockchain-backed storage, Stablecoin payments (USDC), and interoperable data standards to support transparent, compliant, and scalable data sharing. We are turning health data into a liquid digital asset - one that funds innovation and rewards the individuals behind the information.

Name: Deskins Europe
Description:
Deskins Europe B.V. introduces the Deskins RapidFloc dewatering system. Commercializing Science

In science we live in a world of curious people, people who are looking to find new ways to cure disease, eradicate infection or a new way to measure a molecule that could never be measured before. Cutting edge of today is routine tomorrow. The good thing is, beautiful new science maybe translated to applied science a lot faster. The question is, will it become the product applying science in a routine environment?

However reality is we live in a world of stretched financial goals, whether you are finding a new cure or commercializing your new discovery. This is h the cross-roads where science and commercialization meet. These two worlds are often seen as oil and water, not mixing at all! Still we need to find a mutual ground.

During the late 90’s the valuation of knowledge became common practice in many universities and publicly funded scientific institutions. The current EU Horizon 2020 grants are actively looking to involve “those who can sell” in grant applications. The aim to commercialize knowledge is an essential requirement to help institutes in funding ongoing research programs. To make this happen oil and water will have to mix early in the process.

Therefore commercial scientists with a good business experience will guide the process and to set attainable goals. Combining the best of both worlds, commercial and scientific will ensure future research and funding.

Commercializing science has become a reality and it’s up to curious people to make it work!

Name: QIAGEN
Description:
Making improvements in life possible is more than our vision. It is the reason QIAGEN exists.
 
From combating cancer and diagnosing infectious diseases to keeping food and communities safe, the world's most urgent challenges begin with unlocking the insights hidden in DNA and RNA, the building blocks of life. That is where we come in.
 
We are QIAGEN, a Netherlands-based global leader in Sample to Insight solutions. Our technologies isolate and process DNA, RNA and proteins, prepare them for analysis, and turn complex molecular data into clear, actionable insights. Automation brings it together into seamless workflows for the Life Sciences (academia, pharmaceutical R&D and industrial applications such as forensics) and Molecular Diagnostics for clinical healthcare.
 
Every day, more than 500,000 customers around the world rely on us to extract meaning from genetic material quickly, confidently and accurately, from young scientists and pharma R&D teams to clinical labs and more than 35 Nobel Prize winners.
 
Behind it all are the QIAGENers, more than 5,000 colleagues across 75 nationalities and subsidiaries in 25 countries, united by the three promises in our name: Quality, Ingenuity and Accessibility.
 
We are a partner in progress, backed by a deep commitment to science and better healthcare. That commitment extends beyond the lab to how we operate, including our goal of reaching net zero by 2050.

Name: Leiden Bio Science Park
Description:
Leiden Bio Science Park (LBSP) is the largest and fastest-growing Life Sciences & Health cluster in the Netherlands, and ranks among the top five science parks in Europe.

The park is home to more than 500 organisations, ranging from innovative start-ups and scale-ups to leading multinationals. It also hosts world-class research institutions such as Leiden University, Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) and the Netherlands Centre for Drug Development (CHDR), as well as specialised training facilities like the Biotech Training Facility.

Every day, more than 26,000 professionals and 27,000 students work and study here, covering the entire value chain from drug discovery to production. The LBSP offers education at all levels, from vocational training to PhD programmes, ensuring a strong talent pipeline.

The cluster’s main focus areas include vaccines and infectious diseases, regenerative medicine and advanced therapies (ATMPs), early diagnostics and new technologies, prevention and lifestyle innovations, and data, AI and MedTech.

New laboratories, offices, housing, and public facilities are being developed to meet the growing demand for space and to transform the LBSP into a vibrant innovation district — a place where people can work, live and collaborate in close proximity.

For more information, visit our website.

PHC has established a worldwide reputation as a manufacturer of high-quality and innovative medical and laboratory equipment over the past forty years. From early discovery through to IND-enabling studies and GMP manufacturing, Symeres provides integrated expertise in medicinal chemistry, ADME-Tox, bioanalysis, solid-state chemistry, process development, CMC, and regulatory strategy and submission support.

Name: hollandbio
Description: The mission of hollandbio, the Dutch biotech industry association, is to maximize the contribution of biotech innovations to our society’s health and sustainability. We represent, support and connect an active, privately funded, and rapidly growing community of more than 280 member companies. Our members are a reflection of the biotech sector: from start-ups and SMEs to large companies and multinationals, active in fields ranging from healthcare and agri-food to biobased applications and cultured meat. By tackling the obstacles that hinder our frontrunners, hollandbio aims for progress - even when that means challenging the status quo.

Name: Genzyme Europe B.V.
Description:
Genzyme is committed to discovering and delivering transformative therapies for patients with rare and special unmet medical needs, providing hope where there was none before.

Genzyme has pioneered the development and delivery of transformative therapies for over 30 years. Founded in 1981 in Boston, Massachusetts, Genzyme evolved from a tiny start-up with just a handful of employees to one of the world's leading biotech companies. Acquired by Sanofi in 2011, Genzyme now benefits from the reach and resources of one of the world’s largest pharmaceutical companies, with a shared commitment to improving the lives of patients. 

Genzyme has long been known for our expertise in the class of rare genetic diseases known as lysosomal storage disorders (LSDs). LSDs remain the heart of our company today, but we have also expanded – through both in-house development and strategic acquisitions and partnerships – to other disease areas such as thyroid cancer and multiple sclerosis.

Driven by our commitment to patients, we strive to develop strong relationships with patient communities and listen to their perspectives so that we can truly understand their needs. These collaborations guide us as we continue to push the boundaries of medicine and technology to develop new and better therapies where none existed before.

Name: LUMICKS
Description:
LUMICKS is the leading supplier of dynamic single-molecule and cell avidity analysis instruments. Our instruments enable – for the first time – the analysis of complex dynamic details related to the behavior and interaction of single molecules and cells. 

Built upon innovative and Nobel Prize-winning technologies, such as optical tweezers (Nobel Prize for Physics 2018), and STED super-resolution (Nobel Prize for Chemistry 2014), our tools enable the understanding of life to the smallest detail.

Our goal is to advance science and improve human health, by providing tools that unlock the measurement of forces and interactions in biology. For the first time ever, our unapparelled solutions can assist research by directly linking structural and ‘omics analysis to functional outcomes at both a molecular and a cellular level. This is achieved by applying and measuring forces around biological interactions, enabling the detailed real-time analysis of underlying biological mechanisms.

Name: KeyGene
Description:
KeyGene is the go-to research company developing technology innovation for crop improvement, for and with our shareholders (Enza Zaden, Rijk Zwaan, Limagrain Vegetable Seeds, and Takii) and other partners. 

With our intellectual capital, solution driven approach and collaborative spirit, we work for the future of global agriculture with our shareholders and other partners in the AgriFood sector. Using our proprietary technologies, we support customers with the development of new and improved crops. Our goal is to support organizations with their toughest R&D challenges, combining our cutting edge breeding technologies, bioinformatics & data science expertise and trait technologies. 

KeyGene was founded in 1989 by a number of Dutch seed companies. The company started as a molecular marker specialist that revolutionized plant breeding by the development of its DNA fingerprinting technology. Today, innovative research remains at the heart of our company and drives us to deliver novel crop improvement solutions for our partners. At KeyGene, we work in an international environment with more than 120 professionals from all over the world. Our company is based in Wageningen, the Netherlands, and Rockville, MD, USA. 

www.keygene.com

Name: AHV International
Description: We keep animals healthy, reduce antibiotic dependence, and ensure farmers can profitably feed the world sustainably. We do this with scientifically-backed animal health solutions that enable antibiotic reduction and preventive health for livestock.

Name: VectorY
Description:
VectorY combines the therapeutic potential of antibodies and gene therapy to develop long-lasting therapeutic solutions for large disease areas of high unmet medical need.

By combining state-of-the-art technologies and novel and scientific concepts, VectorY’s mission is to bring innovative therapies to patients worldwide.

Founded in August 2020, and based in the Amsterdam Science Park, VectorY is a fully integrated gene therapy company focused on the development of innovative therapeutics such as vectorized antibodies for both CNS and somatic disorders, with a special focus on muscle diseases.

With R&D and manufacturing facilities in Amsterdam, VectorY develops proprietary & partnered programs based on its novel AAV-based vectorized antibody & gene therapy platform. Product candidates are based on new vector technologies, which will enable the next generation of highly scalable manufacturing processes within VectorY’s own manufacturing facilities. Our manufacturing capabilities will include a state-of-the-art multi-product GMP facility in the Netherlands, with the capability to deliver suspension based AAV viral vector manufacturing of up to 2000L for both clinical and commercial supply.
