Lab Associates is a one-stop ‘shop’ for its customers and can build and equip a complete laboratory. Our focus is on core products such as automated systems, media preparators, dispensing machines, autoclaves, culture vessels, laboratory tools and furniture, biochemicals and gelling agents (e.g. agar).

Name: NoPalm Ingredients
Description: NoPalm Ingredients employs a unique fermentation process using non-GMO proprietary yeasts combined with a patented low-capex technology that is quick to scale. This process transforms upcycled, locally sourced agri-food side streams, such as potato peels and whey permeate, into yeast oils and fats. Feedback from customers indicates that NoPalm Ingredients oils and fats are an ideal drop-in replacement for palm oil and an effective alternative for other tropical oils, requiring no recipe reformulation and achieving price parity. Additionally, the technology also boasts a 90% reduction in CO2 emissions and a 99% decrease in land use compared to traditional palm oil production.

Name: LAVA Therapeutics N.V.
Description:
At LAVA, we are focused on applying our expertise in gamma-delta T-cell engagers (TCEs) to transform cancer therapy. We refer to our compounds as gamma-delta bispecific T-cell engagers, or gamma-delta bsTCEs. Our platform generates therapeutics that specifically activate a unique and relatively abundant effector gamma-delta T-cell subset called Vγ9Vδ2 (Vgamma9-Vdelta2) T-cells that have the ability to trigger activity of immune cells of both the innate and adaptive immune system. Our gamma-delta bsTCEs have demonstrated superior efficacy and safety profiles compared to other bsTCE approaches in preclinical studies and show preferential activity against tumor cells thereby potentially limiting toxicity in healthy tissue. To date, we are the only company developing bispecific gamma-delta T-cell engaging antibodies for the treatment of cancer.

We are building a pipeline of gamma-delta bsTCEs that have applications in both solid and hematologic malignancies. Our lead program, LAVA-051, targets the tumor specific antigen CD1d, which can be overexpressed in multiple myeloma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL), and acute myeloid leukemia (AML), among other tumor types. LAVA-051 will enter a Phase I/IIa study in 1Q21.

Name: Prilenia
Description:
Prilenia is a clinical-stage biotech company focused on developing novel treatments for neurodegenerative and neurodevelopmental disorders.

Our lead asset is Pridopidine, a first-in-class oral drug candidate with an established safety profile and potential in multiple movement disorders and neurodegenerative diseases affecting adults and children.

Pridopidine is currently being evaluated for the treatment of Huntington’s disease in our global Phase 3 PROOF-HD trial, and for the treatment of ALS in the Phase 2/3 HEALEY platform trial.

The company is led by Dr. Michael Hayden, MD, PhD, the founder of five biotech companies and previous President of Global R&D and Chief Scientific Officer at Teva. Michael has directed the development of multiple innovative drug products, leading to 35 approvals between 2012-2018.

The Company is based in Naarden, the Netherlands, Herzliya, Israel and Boston, MA in the U.S.

Name: Leyden Labs
Description:
Leyden Labs aims to help people live their lives to the fullest. Our platform targets commonalities of viral families to protect humanity from known and future viruses. Our portfolio of accessible intranasal product candidates may provide people with the freedom to immediately protect themselves from and prevent the spread of many variants of respiratory viruses, including ones in the influenza and coronavirus families.

The Leyden Labs’ energetic team of world-renowned biotechnology veterans and fresh talent is dedicated to thinking differently to free humanity from the burden of respiratory viruses.

Name: Veramaris
Description:
Veramaris is committed to supporting the growth of aquaculture by offering the world's richest source of Omega-3 EPA & DHA through its ASC-MSC-certified algal oil for fish and shrimp feed.

By harnessing nature’s original source of Omega-3, Veramaris helps to ensure the nutritional quality of aquaculture feed, for better animal health and performance, and less waste. This helps to meet the growing demand for more nutritious and higher-quality seafood without increasing the pressure on fisheries.  

From our headquarters in Delft, Netherlands to our advanced production facility in Blair, Nebraska, we collaborate with value chain partners to support the seafood industry in both creating and capturing value through sustainable practices and innovative solutions.

Name: SRC-Search
Description:
650+ commercial global hires across -omics since 2012. One market, one focus.

Name: MILabs
Description:
MILabs empowers researchers to see biology with depth and confidence, generating reliable, reproducible insights that advance scientific discovery and real-world impact.

With decades of scientific leadership in high-resolution preclinical imaging, MILabs develops modular molecular and anatomical imaging systems that help researchers visualize meaningful signals, quantify complex biological processes, and generate evidence that holds up across studies.

Through flexible configurations, streamlined workflows, and close scientific collaboration, MILabs enables research teams to adapt their imaging capabilities as scientific questions evolve.

Name: HALIX
Description:
HALIX is a Healthcare CDMO specializing in biopharmaceuticals, including recombinant proteins and antibodies, viral vectors and vaccines. 

With state-of-the-art GMP manufacturing facilities in Leiden Bio Science Park, we support pharmaceutical companies worldwide with the development & commercialization of biologics enabling the treatment & prevention of life threatening conditions such as cancer, COVID-19, influenza and other infectious diseases. 

At HALIX, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions, fostering meaningful partnerships, and upholding our promise to drive impact in the biotech and healthcare industries with quality, compliance, and sustainability at the heart of every process.

Name: Crucell
Description:
Crucell is a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to bringing meaningful innovation to global health. We do this by discovering, developing, manufacturing and marketing products that combat major threats to the health of people worldwide. Our specialty is fighting infectious diseases—a growing healthcare challenge. 

 Innovation is the drive force behind our strong research & development (R&D) pipeline, with promising products in pre-clinical and clinical development. Crucell product candidates include flu-mAb, and antibody product effective against a broad range of influenza virus strains, tuberculosis and malaria vaccines, as well as a rabies monoclonal antibody combination-all produced on our unique PER.C6 human-cell technology.

Currently we are combating twelve major infectious diseases with our range of marketed vaccines in the paediatric, travel & endemic and respiratory fields. We are the largest independent vaccine company in the world. 

The combination of our innovative technologies and creative minds drives Crucell’s success, which we measure in human and business terms. 

Headquartered in Leiden, the Netherlands, Crucell currently employs over 1300 people and has offices in China, Indonesia, Italy, Korea, Malaysia, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, the UK the USA and Vietnam. Crucell N.V. is listed on NYSE Euronext and NASDAQ (CRXL) and the SIX Swiss Exchange (CRX).

Name: BaseClear
Description:
BaseClear helps organizations transform biological samples into reliable, actionable insights that support research, product development, manufacturing, quality control, and regulatory decision-making. Whether you are developing a new biopharmaceutical, optimizing a microbial production process, investigating a microbiome, or characterizing a cell line, you need more than data alone. You need accurate results, expert interpretation, and a partner who understands the scientific, operational, and regulatory challenges of your project. BaseClear provides the genomics, molecular biology, and quality solutions needed to help clients make confident decisions and accelerate innovation.

What makes BaseClear distinctive is the combination of more than 30 years of genomics expertise with modern sequencing platforms, qPCR, digital PCR, laboratory automation, bioinformatics, and GMP-compliant quality systems. We take a customer-centric approach, tailoring workflows to each project while providing dedicated project management, transparent communication, and end-to-end support from sample receipt to final report. By combining scientific depth with operational excellence, BaseClear delivers high-quality, reproducible results that help clients move projects forward faster and with greater confidence.

Name: Loop Biotech
Description: We are here to enrich nature. We do this by bringing human nutrients back into the cycle-of-life in the most natural way with a living mycelium-based coffin that enables people to enrich the soil and allow new seedlings to thrive. From graveyard to forest.

Name: Planet B.io
Description:
Planet B.io is a non-profit organization established to develop the Biotech Campus Delft into the scale up campus for industrial biotechnology in Europe. We focus on two activities: we provide biotech firms access to top class labs and offices; second, we actively support collaboration in an ecosystem that offers biotech firms whatever they need to scale up and grow.

Planet B.io is a fast-growing organization, with a team that consists of high performing professionals, glued together by fascination for biotech and passion to improve the world. At Planet B.io, we believe that the innovation power of modern biotechnology enables us to develop solutions that help the transition from a depleting, polluting, fossil-based economy, into a sustainable, biobased and circular economy. Our mission is to accelerate this transition.

Name: Scenic Biotech
Description: Scenic Biotech's lead program addresses lysosomal storage disorders and neurodegeneration. A first in class break through that is about to enter clinical development. Scenic's robust pipeline for neurometabolic diseases is derived from its proprietary Cell-Seq discovery platform. In addition, the platform is leveraged through strategic R&D collaborations with Genentech, BMS, Alnylam and Ono. By unlocking new pathways in the genome, Scenic Biotech is developing a range of modifier therapies to help patients.

Name: Sciential - Digital Marketing for Life Sciences Brands
Description:
Sciential is a digital marketing agency that provides online marketing solutions for companies operating in life sciences and health. Whether your company is targeting consumers, medical professionals, CROs, clinical subjects, academic institutions, or big pharma, Sciential is your go-to marketing partner.

Sciential goes beyond traditional marketing agencies and helps your company to promote and sell products or services using innovative digital technologies, data, and analytics. Our consultants support you in achieving more leads and sales while helping you to better identify the needs of your target customers. The digital marketing campaigns are designed in a way that is data-driven and cost-efficient. The Sciential team consists of digital marketing and data science experts with a solid understanding of the life sciences and health market.

Our client network includes companies, research organizations, non-profits, and medical facilities in Europe. The head office is located in Rotterdam, the Netherlands, where we are connected with local life sciences and health hubs.

Name: Single Cell Discoveries
Description:
Single Cell Discoveries is the leading single-cell sequencing CRO providing high-impact insights to biopharmaceutical companies, health systems, and academic research centers globally.

We offer single-cell, spatial, and bulk transcriptomics. Our R&D team is actively developing novel single-cell sequencing technologies, multi-omic applications, and spatial transcriptomics.

Name: Bi/ond
Description:
Achieve accurate disease models and more personalized medicine, by recreating human physiology and pathology in a 3D model. Bi/ond’s customizable Organ-on-Chips (OOCs) are built to outperform the limitation of standard in vitro assays.
 
In the early phase of drug testing, Petri dishes and animals can fall short of predicting what happens inside the human body.  
Bi/ond is where biology meets engineering : our intimate working relationship with biologists helped realize the supportive role engineering can play in generating reproducible and accurate biological models. We develop a lab technology for dynamic cell culture environments that allow for more precise drug testing and simulations of any tissue type. We also empower organizations with valid alternatives to the use of animals in testing (3Rs).

Name: Biotech Booster
Description: Biotech Booster is a national program to support commercialization of biotechnology findings. The Biotech Booster program offers mentorship, financial support and networking opportunities, to guide founders from the idea stage to developing an investable/commercial proposition.

Name: NyBerMan Bioinformatics Europe
Description:
The objective of NyBerMan Bioinformatics Europe is to establish a comprehensive global platform that provides outstanding training, consultation, outsourcing services, and solutions across various domains, including General Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Structural Bioinformatics, Molecular Modeling, Computational Drug Design, Molecular Dynamics Simulations, Multi-OMICS, Chemoinformatics, Biostatistics, Data Science, Programming, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Systems Biology, Intellectual Property Rights (IPR), and Health Informatics. In addition, we provide a unique telegram-based platform through which Bio/BIT professionals exchange their ideas and seek solutions to Bio/BIT-related queries associated with their research projects.

Name: Eurofins Food, Feed & Water Benelux
Description:
Eurofins Food, Feed, Water Benelux levert een belangrijke bijdrage aan de borging van voedsel- en waterveiligheid. Eurofins ziet dit als een van haar belangrijkste taken Meer dan ooit willen we weten wat we eten. We willen weten hoe ons voedsel is geproduceerd, of boeren eerlijk worden beloond en of de informatie op het etiket overeenkomt met de inhoud van de verpakking. Met een wereldwijd kennisnetwerk van maar liefst 800 laboratoria, 50.000 collega’s in 45 landen, helpen wij onze klanten met kwaliteit en veiligheid, zich te houden aan de regelgeving, hun kosten te verlagen en verspilling te voorkomen. •	Voedsel- en waterveiligheid ;

Een bijdrage leveren aan de wereldwijde gezondheid en (voedsel)veiligheid door onze klanten te voorzien van hoogwaardige laboratorium- en adviesdiensten. Daarnaast willen wij kansen scheppen voor onze medewerkers en een duurzaam rendement genereren voor onze aandeelhouders.

CytoSMART believes that high-end innovative tools should be accessible by all those trying to be at the forefront of scientific discovery. By working together, CytoSMART can help those at the cutting edge of life science research, to achieve greatness.

To do this, we focus on the aspects innovation, usability and costs effectiveness in everything we do. Name: Viscon Plant Technology
Description:
Viscon Plant Technology provides equipment and solutions for plant labs and multi-layer cultivation systems — supporting tissue culture, seed, and cutting propagation, as well as leafy crop production.

Name: BioChek - Smart Veterinary Diagnostics
Description:
Shaping the future of animal health
Veterinarians, farmers, and laboratory experts all share the same mission: keeping livestock healthy, preventing disease, and collaborating seamlessly. After all, herd livestock health is their top priority. This is where BioChek steps in, shaping the future of animal health as the trusted diagnostic partner to poultry and swine farmers and producers, vets and veterinary laboratories.

BioChek’s head office is based in Reeuwijk, the Netherlands, with R&D departments in the UK and Germany, a USDA-licensed facility in the US, a regional office in South Africa, regional and local sales teams, and numerous distributors worldwide.

Name: RIBOPRO

RIBOPRO is an innovative service provider, producing high-quality, high-performance RNA products, which are used as powerful research tools and therapeutics.

Name: Synaffix
Description:
Synaffix BV is a biotech company that has established a proprietary, clinical-stage antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) technology platform that delivers best-in-class ADCs (safety and efficacy).  

Our platform is commercially validated by well over $7.6 billion in technology out-licensing deals with partners including ADC Therapeutics, Mersana Therapeutics, Shanghai Miracogen, Innovent Biologics, ProfoundBio and Kyowa Kirin.

Name: EV Biotech
Description:
EV Biotech is a microbial cell factory (MCF) strain development company.  EV Biotech distinguishes itself by the use of state-of-the-art computational modelling. Using cutting-edge scientific developments in systems biology we create computational models of bacterial strains to predict most optimal strain modifications, growth media supplementation and scale up optimization in line with the rational design strategy. 

Fast-feedback loop between strain modellers and engineers increases development speed and efficiency of the MCF strain development pipeline. Preliminary models can be updated and enhanced quickly if needed, due to a close collaboration between a theoretical and experimental departments.

EV Biotech creates highly effective compound production strains on demand. 

Contact us for an offer.

Name: SkylineDx BV
Description:
At SkylineDx, we live to make a difference. It is our mission to improve a patient’s quality of life by enabling them to benefit from personal insights at the genomic level of their disease. That means we are continuously innovating the world of gene signature-based diagnostic testing.

Genes are responsible for making us who we are. It can determine our features such hair and eye color, skin tone, or even height. Although we know our genetic make-up is similar to one another, each individual is vastly unique. “No two humans are alike.”

And while most agree on the quote above, the contrary is being practiced in disease treatment today. When a patient gets a cancer diagnosis, he or she is treated, more or less, the same as other patients with the same type of cancer. For decades we have known, but were not able to determine why patients with the same diagnosis respond differently to the same treatment. Today, after years of genetic research, we know that like humans, no two cancer cells are alike. And for that reason, we now know cancer treatments should differ case by case, because cancer cells are inherently different.

At SkylineDx, we have a team of experts with the knowledge and capability to collaborate with highly respected physicians and patients advocates. Together we work to achieve the same multi-disciplinary goal: to give physicians the genetic tools to better guide the most affective treatment plan for their patients.

This principle of individualized treatment plans is called personalized- or precision medicine and is extremely important for the patient. With the right personalized treatment, at the right moment, the patient can avoid side effects from over or undertreatment, which means less hospitalization, complications, medications, and ultimately better quality of life.

Name: Viroclinics-DDL
Description:
Viroclinics operates at a global level, being the preferred virology testing laboratory for several of the top-10 Biopharmaceutical companies. Name: Intravacc

Ambagon is discovering and developing small molecule cancer drugs that stabilize the direct interaction of oncogenic proteins with the 14-3-3 class of adaptor proteins.

Onze missie 
De productiviteit van dieren verhogen om de wereld te helpen voeden en het genot van groene ruimten vergroten.

Onze visie 
We zijn de voorkeurspartner voor innovatieve en duurzame voeder- en grasoplossingen, door het delen van onze mondiale expertise met onze lokale klanten. De klant komt op de eerste plaats binnen het bedrijf, waardoor de ervaring met Barenbrug op elk niveau uitmuntend is. Dat is onze toezegging, onze Barenbrug-belofte.

Name: RespectFarms
Description: We believe farmers can create value and earn money with cellular agriculture technology. That is why we will create the world's first farm that produces meat from cells and not from animals.
Location: Den Haag, Zuid-holland, South Holland, Netherlands

Name: Portal Biotech
Description:
Proteins are at the heart of every biological process, yet today’s tools still leave major blind spots. At Portal Biotech, we're developing the first platform capable of sequencing entire proteins at the single-molecule level, replacing fragmented views with a complete picture. We want to empower scientists to understand proteins in depth and in real time, enabling faster drug discovery, more accurate diagnostics, and stronger pandemic readiness. 

Portal Biotech was founded by DNA-sequencing veterans, leveraging machine-learning algorithms and building on decades of in-house expertise in nanopore technology. By analysing full-length protein molecules at the single-molecule level, our platform delivers rapid, real-time information on protein identity, abundance, and structure. Those insights open frontiers in drug discovery, diagnostics, and fundamental research, helping scientists and clinicians to better understand human health and disease.

We’re looking for sharp minds to help bring this vision to life.

Name: DAB.bio
Description:
DAB.bio develops and deploys cutting-edge fermentation technology. Our unique and patented FAST platform (Fermentation Accelerated by Separation Technology) enables continuous fermentation with cost reductions of 20-50% or more and is one of the most significant fermentation innovations of the past decade.

The global focus on synthetic biology has delivered breakthrough routes to replace fossil-based chemicals with sustainable bio-based alternatives. High manufacturing costs currently hamper the large-scale manufacturing of many of these alternatives. FAST addresses this issue head-on. It is the largest contributor to lowering manufacturing costs and facilitating large-scale deployment of bio-based chemicals. DAB.bio promises a significant impact.

Name: PHENOSPEX
Description:
Accelerating Sustainable Agriculture

Millions of researchers, agricultural companies, and farmers globally are working hard to create solutions that reduce farming's environmental impact. We believe digitalization will be the major driver in this process. Our digital phenotyping solutions capture crop data and turn it into actionable insights, accelerating the transition to sustainable agriculture.

Phenotyping is fundamental to the development of new agrochemicals, new plant varieties, and farming itself. Phenotyping is traditionally done visually or destructively – it’s time consuming, expensive, and imprecise. Our mission is to automate the process, make the data actionable, and enable our clients to deliver new agrochemicals and crops faster than ever before.

We empower seed companies, crop protection companies, and indoor farms around the world in transforming their phenotyping processes into digital, agile and efficient development pipelines. Combining our expertise in sensors, automation, and data analysis with our clients’ know-how, we’re driving transformation.

Join Phenospex

Join us to tackle complex problems at the intersection of high tech and nature. Your work will impact sustainable agriculture through our innovative digital phenotyping technology. Be part of a team that advances technology and makes a real difference.

Our Culture

We foster an open and informal culture, with transparent communication about company performance. We value your freedom, commitment, and responsibilities, owning and adapting processes to serve our goals better.

Our Team

You'll join an ambitious, intelligent, and diverse group of international professionals who believe they can change the world. We enjoy spending time together outside of work, engaging in activities like bouldering, wakeboarding, and cycling, fostering strong camaraderie and community.

Apply

If you're passionate about shaping the future of agriculture: https://phenospex.com/careers/

Name: Solvias NL (formerly Cergentis)
Description:
Solvias NL, formerly known as Cergentis is a trusted genomics-focused biotech company providing services and in-house solutions based on its proprietary genomic analysis platform to all leading biopharmaceutical companies and renowned research institutes. With our widely published and recognized genetic analyses, we support our global customer base in the characterization and QC of their genetically engineered models, biopharmaceutical cell line development and cell- and gene therapy products. By helping to de-risk R&D program decisions, minimizing time-to-clinic, providing objective genomic evidence for regulators, and supporting patient safety, we aim to support biopharmaceutical medicine development programs worldwide. 

For more information, visit solvias.com.

Name: Vico Therapeutics
Description: Vico Therapeutics is committed to advancing RNA modulating therapies for patients with severe, genetic neurological disorders. Vico is initially targeting spinocerebellar ataxia types 3 and 1 and Huntington’s disease. Our VICOMER platform designs antisense oligonucleotides for various genetic defects by modulating or editing RNA. For more information, visit www.vicotx.com

Name: Regenerative Medicine Utrecht
Description:
We are scientists from the UMC Utrecht, Utrecht University, and Hubrecht Institute working together on regenerative medicine. This page posts news and relevant updates for the RM community in Utrecht and beyond. 
Click the bell and choose 'All new posts' so you don't miss an update!

Name: Insect School
Description:
We are Insect School.

We want to create a sustainable future for our children, by unleashing a chain reaction of people and companies contributing to global circular food production.

Commercially growing the Black Soldier Fly is one of the most effective steps towards this circular food production. The BSF larva provides the best source of animal protein and is a high-quality food source for pigs, chickens, fish, and pets. Our goal is to make BSF farming as commercially attractive as possible to companies. And to increase our impact, we share our knowledge and experience. With Insect School, we make our expertise available to the whole world.

Insect School is founded by Insect Engineers, which develops, builds, and supplies machinery and climate systems for the global BSF industry in feed. Solutions for the entire production process, from breeding to production and processing.

Find out more on insectengineers.com

Name: Molecular Biology Systems
Description: Molecular Biology Systems, B.V., founded in 2015, is a molecular biology solutions company based in the Netherlands. Our NextGenPCR thermocycler uses patented heating and cooling technology to reduce PCR amplification cycling times from hours to minutes. These technological advances support laboratories across the life sciences market, reduce costs and accelerate processing times. NextGenPCR, the amplification technology of the future, now available.

Name: GECCO Biotech
Description:
GECCO Biotech supports companies in developing enzyme-driven technologies across various industries, including pharmaceuticals, flavours, fragrances, and food technology. This represents a move toward more sustainable, efficient, and environmentally friendly manufacturing processes.

With our biocatalysis expertise, we offer comprehensive support in implementing enzymatic solutions in your pipeline, serving as a one-stop shop for diverse services tailored to meet the biotechnological needs of our customers.

Name: UgenTec
Description:
UgenTec is a molecular laboratory software provider servicing molecular labs, assay and instrument providers globally across applications in Clinical Molecular Diagnostics, Veterinary health, Crop Science, Breeding and Seed Health. UgenTec is headquartered in Hasselt, Belgium with offices in Boston, MA and its FastFinder platform has a global installed base of over 100 molecular labs and partnerships with leading molecular diagnostics vendors.
FastFinder is a modular, clinical grade Software as a Service platform using AI methods allowing labs of all sizes to standardize and automate their molecular workflows. FastFinder’s modules include Analysis, Genotyper and Workflow.

Name: Biocult
Description:
Biocult is an independent service provider and development partner for biotech and diagnostics companies active in the global IVD market.

We support companies facing shortages in manufacturing capacity as well as organizations that need highly specialized expertise for the development, validation and production of in‐vitro diagnostic (IVD) tests.
Our services start from early development through transfer to manufacturing, we help our partners turn ideas into robust, scalable diagnostic products.

With 30+  years of experience, we work with biotech companies worldwide. We operate under ISO 13485 certification and work exclusively with high‐quality reagents, materials, and highly trained personnel. By combining development know‐how with manufacturing capabilities, Biocult enables its clients to deliver state‐of‐the‐art diagnostic solutions that contribute to cost‐effective healthcare and reliable medical decision.

Together we create greatness!

Name: Fruitleather Rotterdam
Description:
"Fruitleather Rotterdam’s mission is to provide the world with an eco and animal friendly material. Contributing to a greener and more bio-based future.

When the company was first founded in 2016, our main goal was to find a new use for the large amount of fruit waste. Situated near the port of Rotterdam, large amounts of fruits being imported will never find its way to the consumer. We believe this could change from now on, as it can be transformed into a durable leather-like material suitable for different applications. 

What if we did not see fruit waste as a residue but as a valuable starting material? By doing so, we are able to bring a eco-friendly and animal-friendly product to the market.

The two worlds of fruit and leather are combined where the waste of the fruit industry is used to radically change the world of the polluting leather industry."

Name: Aminoverse
Description:
Aminoverse is all about enzymes.

We support you in inventing and establishing enzyme-based applications and products as a trustworthy CRO partner, fusing enzyme wet lab R&D with AI, in silico design, and biophysical simulations. From enzyme discovery to enzyme feasibility studies, enzyme production and quality control to joint enzyme development and enzyme evolution - we are ready to explore the Aminoverse with you.

De-risk and accelerate enzyme development with Aminoverse's proprietary AI tech stack covering EnzyNAV AI (for identifying the right enzyme), EnzyMAP AI (for selecting the truly best mutations), and EnzyREC AI (to recombine the best mutations).

For Chemists: We support your move from lab concept up to ton-scale production. Our focus is on maximizing process economics with customized enzymes and process conditions, merging chemistry with biocatalysis into elegant manufacturing processes that work.

For Product Developers: Create high-performance products that stand out. We help you find and design the right enzyme to secure new IP and ensure your next innovation has a clear competitive edge.

For Strain Engineers: Remove the bottlenecks in your synthesis pathway. We focus on establishing the most efficient enzymatic routes to improve product yields and turn your strain into a profitable microbial factory.

For Bioanalysts: Enzymes bring surgical precision for the toughest challenges. We make tailored enzymes accessible, helping you create entirely new detection principles, improve diagnostic accuracy, and streamline routine assays.

Got an enzyme challenge for us? We'd love to hear about it.

Name: TargED Biopharmaceuticals
Description: TargED started in September 2018 and is currently developing one biopharmaceutical product: MICROLYSE. MICROLYSE enzymatically breaks down blood clots in small blood vessels (i.e. the microvasculature), for which to date, no specific treatment exists. TargED pursues to receive market authorization for an orphan disease named Thrombotic Thrombocytopenic Purpura (TTP) that is characterized by life threatening attacks of microvascular thrombosis. However, MICROLYSE has the capacity to target all forms of microvascular thrombosis and could also be applied in early-stage macrovascular thrombosis as seen in heart attacks and stroke.

Name: TRACER
Description:
At TRACER we are specialized in first-in-human studies with the use of nuclear and optical molecular imaging techniques.

By labeling an antibody, small molecule, peptide, nanoparticle, protein, or any other compound of interest with a fluorescent dye or a radionuclide, fast in human data can be obtained with an indication of the potential efficacy of the novel drug, even before the classical phase 1-3 clinical trials. This can lead to a more efficient and less costly drug development process.

We assist our sponsors in the labeling of their lead compounds and execute first-in-human studies to visualize and quantify the biodistribution and pharmacokinetics of the compound. With this information a “ go/no-go” decision can be made before the compound proceeds to the next phase in clinical development where costs are larger and time is valuable.

Early in-human studies are approved by the EMA and FDA through the so-called principle of microdosing. It allows you to often skip (large) animal models and go straight into the patient population.

Name: Schoneveld Breeding
Description:
Wij veredelen en produceren een nieuwe generatie bloeiende potplanten die duurzamer kunnen worden gekweekt. Op deze manier dragen we bij aan een bloeiende toekomst voor de volgende generaties.

Schoneveld Breeding creëert extra waarde voor alle partners in de keten. Wij doen dit door krachtige genetica, teeltondersteuning en relevante marktintroducties te bieden. Op deze manier werken we samen aan een hoger rendement voor de gehele keten.

Ons portfolio omvat Illusia-, Gerbera-, Gaultheria-, Cyclamen-, Primula-, Ranunculus- en Campanula-rassen.

Name: Barenbrug Group
Description: A world of possibilities–that’s what Joseph Barenbrug pictured when he saw grass. He initiated the development of varieties for different purposes that is still ongoing today. These varieties are suitable for a wide range of climates. Tasty and healthy forages with high nutritional value for cattle, fine leaved and attractive green grass for parks and gardens, slow-growing grass for lawns, strong grass for sports pitches and recreation. If you can imagine it, we can create it!

Insect Factory Engineering, Design & Training

Name: AZAFAROS B.V.
Description:
We are developing new treatment options to help patients with rare metabolic disorders.

Azafaros was founded in 2018 by a team of experienced industry professionals and scientists aspiring to address rare genetic metabolic disorders through a pipeline of oral small molecules with disease-modifying potential. Based on discoveries from Leiden University and Amsterdam UMC, Azafaros’s proprietary lead compound, nizubaglustat, will initially address inherited life-threatening lysosomal storage diseases for which there are no effective therapies.

This orally available azasugar compound interferes with the metabolism of glycolipids and uniquely affects several key disease pathways through a dual mode of action. Leveraging the know-how of its team and partners in orphan drug development, the company is advancing its lead program in the clinic while further expanding its product pipeline into other rare metabolic diseases through its drug discovery efforts.

Name: Alco Energy Rotterdam B.V.
Description:
Alco Energy Rotterdam is a young biorefinery that was started in 2010 in Europoort Rotterdam. It is one of the largest producers of bioethanol, animal feed and CO2 in Europe.

The Rotterdam factory is part of Alcogroup, one of the largest bioethanol producer in Europe, and Vanden Avenne, a specialized grain trader. As Alco Energy Rotterdam, we are a sustainable organization that have as a goal to be climate-neutral by 2030.

The factory in the Europoort has approximately 120 employees. 

Alco Energy makes a solid contribution to sustainable energy use in transport and protein feed.

Name: Oncolines B.V.
Description:
Oncolines B.V. (Oss, The Netherlands) is a precision medicine services company in oncology and cancer immunotherapy, part of Symeres B.V. (Nijmegen, The Netherlands). We help to bring improved and novel therapies to the right patient population faster.

Our clients are clinical and preclinical biopharmaceutical companies that seek differentiation for their drugs and drug candidates. We offer a set of complimentary services to enable our clients to characterize their compounds, determine activities, selectivities and mechanism of action. We present results in a unique interactive reporting format that facilitates easier and faster interpretation of results.

Oncolines Profiling is the parallel dose-response testing of compounds on a large panel of genetically characterized human cancer cell lines. We analyze the correlation and mutation status of more than 100 cancer genes, to identify drug response biomarkers for selecting the right patient population for clinical trials.

SynergyFinder is the profiling of combinations of drugs, to identify new synergistic drug combinations.

We perform gene and protein expression analysis, DNA and RNA sequencing, and flow cytometry, to investigate the mechanism of action of drug candidates.

ResidenceTimer is the determination of binding kinetics of compound - target interactions. We have more than 100 kinase assays available.

QuickScout is kinase inhibitor profiling in enzyme activity assays at Carna Biosciences, Inc. (Kobe, Japan). We represent Carna in Europe and Israel. 326 wild-type and mutant kinases are available for profiling (% effect and IC50) at Carna.

Name: Nederlandse Biotechnologie Vereniging
Description: De Nederlandse Biotechnologie Vereniging (NBV) is dé beroepsvereniging van professionals werkzaam in de toegepaste Life Sciences. Een waardevol netwerk met ruim 1000 leden afkomstig uit verschillende disciplines van het bedrijfsleven en het hoger/ academisch onderwijs. De NBV wil professionele activiteiten en maatschappelijk verantwoorde beroepsuitoefening stimuleren. Kennisuitwisseling en netwerken staan daarbij centraal. Daarnaast draagt de NBV bij aan een evenwichtige informatievoorziening over nut, belang en maatschappelijke betekenis van de biotechnologie.

Name: Delta Life Science
Description:
Enabling more. For less. It's our mission to make label-free, multiplexed biosensing accessible to all.

Assay Developers need to validate next-gen biomarker panels for more accurate diagnostics. Academic Researchers need to extract more data from precious samples to guide their studies. Pharma Scientists need to speed up drug development by collecting extensive data from a wide range of samples.

The Merits Of Label-Free Biosensing?
Label-free biosensing enables real-time, direct detection without the need for tagging target molecules. This revolutionary approach benefits a wide range of applications, from studying molecular interactions and accelerating drug kinetics-screening to selecting high-quality antibodies based on kinetics and developing real-time quantitative biomarker assays.

Most platforms focus on one aspect—sensitivity, multiplexing, or cost. Researchers need all three. And the high costs mean it's only accessible for big-budget labs.

Powered by photonic integrated circuits, Delta Life Science accelerates research by a factor of 4. By cutting ownership costs by a factor of 5, we make top-notch label-free biosensing accessible to every researcher.

As a spinoff of TNO, we develop integrated photonics to create highly sensitive and selective biosensors. These are an order of magnitude more affordable, measure multiple biomarkers and are extremely sensitive, reaching SPR sensitivity. 
Our chips and readout device can be used anywhere from medical research, agriculture to Point-of-Care diagnostic applications.

Name: Ourobionics
Description: Ourobionics is the first start-up to merge advanced electric, magnetic, and microfluidic 3D biofabrication technology with novel cyborganic technology to create high throughput tissues and organs with embedded bioelectronics, biosensors, and therapeutic agents. We go beyond bioprinting to establish next generation applications in regenerative medicine, medical devices, and human-machine interfaces.

Name: Artinis Medical Systems

Artinis is an innovative Dutch company active in the field of medical research equipment and quality assurance equipment. For more than two decades, we have been providing user-friendly, high-tech solutions for fNIRS measurements and radiological quality management. 2021 remarks our company as ISO 13485:2016 certified for our quality management system. We participate in various scientific projects and work closely together with numerous universities, companies, and institutions around the globe. With extensive knowledge of the field, we develop top-quality products and go above and beyond to support you. 

At Artinis, we make optical imaging easy.

Name: PNO Life Sciences & Health
Description:
ttopstart - Empowering biomedical innovators

It is our mission to empower biomedical innovators. We want to enable their success in tackling the challenges associated with disruptive healthcare innovations, for the benefit of patients. ttopstart employees are amongst the brightest life sciences professionals: we are trained to provide helicopter views across markets and scientific fields. Name: Citryll
Description: Citryll has translated a deep understanding of the extracellular trap (ET) pathway to therapeutically address its central role in a broad range of  immune-mediated inflammatory diseases (IMIDs). Name: AgriGenX
Description:
AgriGenX is a total solutions global supplier of innovative extraction DNA / RNA technology, system, products and kits for human and animal diagnostics,  agriculture and biotech.

From sample to result, AgriGenX is challenging the status quo in molecular diagnostics by offering platform-diagnostic stand-alone systems and consumables. Highly customizable, our portfolio offers the perfect workflow for our customers’ specific needs.

Name: NimaGen
Description:
- Our DNA -
NimaGen, part of the Dutch Biolegio Holding and founded in 2011, is a well-recognized ISO certified manufacturer and vendor of reagents and workflow solutions for Sanger Sequencing and Next Generation Sequencing (NGS). We serve molecular biology laboratories around the world, active in human genetics, forensics, microbiology and infectious disease.

- Our Mission -
NimaGen’s mission is helping laboratories create value for their customers, through proven and cost-effective workflows, providing detailed insights and enabling informed decision making. From clinical research to forensics to agriculture to food safety and environmental hygiene.

- Patented Core Technology - 
Our core technology, Reverse Complement PCR (RC-PCR), provides the most safe, swift and simple worklow for NGS Library Prep. It comprises simultaneous multiplex target amplification and NGS indexing or barcoding in a single, closed tube PCR reaction. Compatible with illumina, Oxford Nanopore Technologies, PacBio and Element Biosciences.

- Sanger Sequencing Workflow Reagents - 
We are the globally recognized provider of a complete workflow portfolio of drop-in reagents for 3130, 3500, 3730 and SeqStudioTM Genetic Analyzers. From PCR purification to dyeterminator reaction cleanup and running samples, to safeguarding capillary operational life span. For DNA sequencing results and data you can trust.

EasySeqTM, IDseek, BrilliantDyeTM, NimaPOPTM, NimaPrimeTM, D-PureTM, iX-PureTM, ExS-PureTM, Alpaqua, AmpliCleanTM, Biolegio.

Name: Nostics
Description:
By applying nanotechnology, photonics and machine learning, Nostics brings a new type of diagnostics to a world desperately in need for 21st century solutions.

Name: CONNECT Symposium 2025
Description:
The quest to cross the human blood-brain barrier (BBB) remains one of the largest challenges we face in neuroscience and medicine today. Scientists work tirelessly from both sides of the issue: from the side of the brain, and from the side of the vasculature to develop compounds and techniques for crossing. In recent years, a number of new human in vitro modeling technologies have greatly aided these endeavors, specifically new brain organoid and BBB models.
 
This is why on January 10th, 2025, we bring you the CONNECT Symposium: a one-day program around recent advances in bioengineering, in vitro BBB modeling and brain organoids. The day will bring together scientists, students, and industry leaders who are interested in or actively developing such models.
 
We unite over two questions: How can we create the most advanced in vitro BBB and brain organoid models? And what becomes possible when we develop models connecting the two?
 
The CONNECT Symposium provides a platform for established and junior scientists from academia and private industry to share their latest discoveries, challenges, and perspectives. The program will feature scientists from around the Netherlands.

Our keynote speakers of the day are Prof. Dr. Adrian Ranga (KU Leuven, BE) and Dr. Roberto Villaseñor (Roche, CH). Prof. Dr. Ranga will share methods for vascularizing cerebral organoids. Dr. Villaseñor will share techniques to generate high throughput in vitro models of the BBB.

The CONNECT Symposium is an initiative of the CONNECT Research Consortium, headed by Prof. Dr. Elly Hol (UMC Utrecht) and Prof. Dr. Elga de Vries (Amsterdam UMC), and funded by NWO.

Name: OYC Europe
Description:
OYC Europe is a wholly owned subsidiary of Oriental Yeast Co., Ltd. of Japan, one of the world’s largest manufacturers of biochemical products such as enzymes, coenzymes (co-factors), monoclonal/polyclonal antibodies, recombinant proteins and superior quality liquid stable chemistry reagents for OEM. OYC has the oldest history of manufacturing coenzymes in the world and since 1968 OYC has been manufacturing biochemical products for the clinical diagnostic industry. OYC Europe is a key supplier of critical raw materials and customized services to the IVD, API, Life Science and Nutraceutical market.

We also function as the European sales and procurement center for food ingredient raw materials to support the core business of Oriental Yeast Co., Ltd. OYC, established in 1929, was the first yeast technology company in Japan and now has more than 13,000 strains of yeast culture stocks.

Name: Green4Print
Description:
Green4Print is een jonge innovatieve toeleverancier voor de grafische industrie. We leveren offset inkt welke gekenmerkt wordt als de ‘meeste groene vellenoffset inkt’ ter wereld. Met onze Groene Menukaart leveren we bovendien producten welke aansluiten op onze visie over een schonere grafische industrie.

Green4Print neemt een vooruitstrevende positie in als innovatieve productontwikkelaar voor de grafische industrie. Met onze innovatieve biobased producten bedienen we de bestaande leveranciers voor de grafische markt en nemen daarmee een unieke positie in in de bedrijfskolom.

Onze bedrijfsfilosofie is gebaseerd op het bieden van echte meerwaarde aan onze opdrachtgevers, een hechte en langdurige relatie met hen op te bouwen en zo tot definitieve oplossingen te komen voor de duurzaamheidstransitie welke onze industrie moet ondergaan. Green4Print staat bekend als kennisinstituut, de kwaliteit en de betrouwbaarheid van haar producten en diensten en tevens om de specifieke kennis en ervaring van de medewerkers.

Name: Multi-Modality Medical Imaging (M3I)
Description:
M3I is a new chair that brings together together the vital ingredients of i) well-educated talent, ii) good ideas, and iii) a strong network of academic, clinical and industrial partners - to perform research, development, demonstration and testing of novel technologies in imaging. Our overarching goal of this ecosystem is to have societal impact through translation of the new technologies, and through training of students and professionals.

We work on developing new imaging technologies for diagnostics, therapy guidance and therapy evaluation. The technologies are intended to provide patient-oriented solutions. Important clinical expertise areas are oncology and cardiovascular medicine. These novel technologies straddle most energy sources from light, to ultrasound, to x-rays and can be non- or minimally invasive, and ultrafast to real-time. Some are based on instrinsic tissues contrasts while others are enabled by the use of targeting markers, including molecular biomarkers, fluorescent tracers, and contrast agents.

The education by M3I serves the curricula of Technical Medicine and Biomedical Engineering with in-depth teaching of imaging concepts, and staff of M3I supervises clinical internships in (university) medical centers. M3I is located in the new Technical Medical Centre, where all health related academic activities of our university are concentrated.

Name: Biobased-Business.eu
Description:
Our biomass experts provide a full and comprehensive consulting service for companies working in or looking for opportunities in renewable energy and biobased business.

We are your experts for the production, combustion and quality control of solid, liquid and gaseous biobased products. Our project managers provide you services such as engineering, project management, feasibility studies and quality certification. Our agricultural experts advise you in crop cultivation.

We have specialists in different fields of work. We support our customers in every phase of a biomass project, from orientation and contract research to exploitation, for (turn-key) installations on a small scale and larger.

We are involved in the realization of ethanol production plants, pyrolyses plants, biogas plants, biomass combustion plants and combinations of these and other technologies. Based on biobased materials, our experts can also use fermentation technology and other methods for providing you with several biobased solutions.

In addition, we draw expertise from a wide network of consultants, providing up to date knowledge, including biomass production (e.g. rape seed, corn, wood) and biomass logistics.

Name: IST Green Chemicals bv
Description:
Sustainable technologies for processing sugar beets. 
Greening the chemical sector.
Making the connection between agriculture and chemistry.

Entering the market with more sustainable and competitive technology, we maintain short distribution lines, enhance quality, reduce transport costs offering higher margins with lasting impact. 

By making the connection between agriculture and chemistry, IST envisions to create advancements in the sustainability of both agriculture and the chemical industry. As a first step in this process, IST has developed a refinery technology that enables the production of four different commercially viable components out of sugar beets.

Name: Antinnitus
Description:
Wij werken aan een wetenschappelijk onderbouwde behandeling voor tinnitus.
Tinnitus treft miljoenen mensen, maar een bewezen therapie ontbreekt nog steeds. Daarom ontwikkelen wij een vernieuwende aanpak op basis van neurowetenschap, gericht op het duurzaam verminderen van de impact van tinnitus.

De eerste resultaten bieden hoop, maar om deze methode onafhankelijk te bewijzen is verder onderzoek nodig. Via crowdfunding maken we klinische studies, dataverzameling en samenwerking met onderzoeksinstellingen mogelijk.

Met steun van onze community bouwen we aan kennis, bewijs en een toekomst waarin tinnitus behandelbaar wordt.
Samen maken we mogelijk wat nu nog niet bestaat.

Wil je ons onderzoek ondersteunen? 
Lees hoe je kunt bijdragen via: 
https://antinnitus.org

Name: Metris
Description:
Development and sales of automated systems for preclinical research (drug development, safety pharmacology, toxicology, phenotyping).

The primary products are:
-  Laboras:  Automated Classification of more than 18 (normal and stereotypical) behaviors of small laboratory animals
-  Sonotrack:  Automated Classification of more than 15 Ultrasonic Vocalizations (calls) of animals
-  Sleepsign:  Automated Classification of Sleep stages of animals   
-  SmartChamber:  Sound isolated and controlled measurement environment

The products are used by most large Pharmaceutical Companies and many Academic Institutes and Contract Research Laboratories (CRO's).

The main goal is to increase the efficiency and quality of preclinical research by enabling shorter experimental lead times, use of less animals, non-invasive methods and lower overall cost.

Name: Metris
Description:
Development and sales of automated systems for preclinical research (drug development, safety pharmacology, toxicology, phenotyping).

The primary products are:
-  Laboras:  Automated Classification of more than 18 (normal and stereotypical) behaviors of small laboratory animals
-  Sonotrack:  Automated Classification of more than 15 types of Ultrasonic Vocalizations of mice and 28 of rats
-  Ratpad:  Automated analysis of cognition in rats using touchscreens in the home cage
-  Sleepsign:  Automated Classification of Sleep stages of animals   
-  SmartChamber:  Sound isolated and controlled measurement environment

The products are used by most large Pharmaceutical Companies, leading Academic Institutes and Contract Research Orgnaizations (CRO's).

The main goal is to increase the efficiency and quality of preclinical research by enabling shorter experimental lead times, use of less animals, non-invasive methods and lower overall cost.

Name: First Health Pharmaceuticals B.V.
Description:
First Health Pharmaceuticals B.V. is a biotech company with its main offices in Amsterdam, the Netherlands. Considering the groundbreaking nature of the RNA Helicase targeting technology, developed by our group, and the vast array of pathogens and malignancies that is targeted by our compounds, it will come as no surprise that many research groups worldwide, directly or indirectly, participated in the research in our field of interest. Some of these collaborations are based on a joint development agreement but most academic groups performed efficacy tests related to pathogens that fit their field of research purely for academic reasons. These collaborations are of mutual benefit. Our research group is the only one in the world that developed a large portfolio of small molecule DDX3 Helicase inhibitors, for use both as  antivirals and anti tumor agents. As such, many highly specialised research groups around the world are interested in testing our compounds, in order to gain more insight in the complex cellular RNA helicase biochemistry, related to the pathogens they are working on. We, from our side, also learn many new things about our field of research, but even in cases in which no direct benefit is to be expected for our company, we still aim to satisfy all requests that reach us from interested academic groups. 
Please visit our website for more information:
http://firsthealthpharma.com/

Name: DC4U Technologies
Description: DC4U is a life science company founded in 2006. Our core expertise is the immunological application of glycobiology. Based on this knowledge a platform technology (GlycoDC) was developed which can modulate the immune system and can be applied to antigen based therapeutics and products.

Name: LabSPX
Description: LabSPX offers a wide range of laboratory equipment and consumables, carefully selected to meet diverse laboratory needs. From setting up new laboratories and upgrading existing equipment to replenishing consumables, we provide the right solutions for every situation!

Name: MCS Diagnostics BV
Description:
MCS Diagnostics – Your Partner in Testing & Quality
Since 1997, MCS Diagnostics has been supporting the dairy, food, cosmetics, clinical, and veterinary sectors with premium testing solutions. We are more than a distributor — we also produce our own rapid microbiological tests and ready prepared media, giving you direct access to reliable, high‐quality products.
 
Our portfolio ranges from rapid microbial and allergen tests to antibiotic, mycotoxin, ATP, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing solutions, along with advanced equipment and full service support. Backed by ISO 9001 certification, in‐house innovation, and the personal approach of a family business, we deliver the expertise and products you can trust - today and tomorrow.

Name: Leidse Biologen Club
Description:
De Leidse Biologen Club (LBC) is sinds november 1923 de studievereniging voor biologiestudenten van de Universiteit Leiden. Inmiddels hebben we meer dan 500 leden. De LBC organiseert als actieve studievereniging elke maand meerdere activiteiten waaronder excursies, een studiereis in het buitenland, symposia, etc. Tevens publiceert de LBC vier keer per jaar het verenigingsblad 'Het Kameleon'.

Jaarlijks is er een beroepenavond waarbij gastsprekers vertellen over de mogelijkheden na de studie. Dit zijn veelal oud LBC leden maar ook bedrijven. 

De LBC wordt draaiende gehouden door de leden, de Universiteit Leiden en door bedrijven. Voor sponsoring mogelijkheden kunt u via email of telefonisch contact met ons opnemen via bestuur@leidsebiologenclub.nl of +31 71 527 4977

Name: APTUS Plant Tech
Description: True Plant Science - High quality, super concentrated, natural plant nutrients and bio-stimulants for maximum plant expression

Name: OPE Group
Description:
The OPE Group is a biotech startup, developing and applying cultivation technology based on undefined mixed microbial communities. Harnessing the advancements in computational power, we have developed proprietary algorithms to apply specific cultivation strategies. These can be employed to cultivate, select or enrich microbial communities which can be applied to improve industrial processes or to discover new natural compounds. with the OPE Group's technology it is not the microbial communities themselves, but the unique cultivation strategy which makes the technology stand out.

The OPE Group is on a mission to improve the quality of life by fully exploring what natural microbiology has to offer. Our vision is that improving the environmental performance and finding novel biobased compounds contributes greatly to our mission. 

The company offers cultivation services to like-minded partners. It is also developing a specific application of its technology to discover new natural leads. We are actively looking for collaborations in both areas.

We can cultivate any microbe, even your microbe!

Name: C5 EU Project
Description:
C5 combines metabolic engineering in cyanobacteria with synthetic cellular organelles to revolutionize the sustainable production of bio-isoprene—a key chemical used in materials, pharmaceuticals, and specialty chemicals.

Funded by the European Union. Grant Agreement 101223091.Views and opinions expressed are however those of the authors only and do not necessarily reflect those of the European Union or the European Innovation Council. Neither the European Union nor the granting authority can be held responsible for them.

Account managed by INsociety.

Name: Studio Hendrikx
Description:
Netherlands based Design Studio led by Bob Hendrikx 

Bob Hendrikx is an inventor, architect and biodesigner who strives to restore the parasitic relationship between humanity and its environment by exploring a living world. Working together with nature and a world in which our everyday objects come to life are important factors in his work. From a living coffin that turns people into plant food to growing a house. Bob was named Human of the Year 2020 by VICE Media. His ambition is to push the boundaries of the human imagination by making science fiction a reality and collaborating with living organisms.

Explore more on www.studiohendrikx.com
#nature #science #design

Name: MCPIR
Description: MCPIR is a unique collaboration of companies within the medicinal cannabis sector. Together, they have established a research center and platform, called MCPIR, where research is being conducted on the most optimal growing conditions for cannabis. The purpose of this five-year initiative is to investigate the most optimal cultivation methods for medicinal cannabis and create a blueprint for further professionalizing the cultivation process. What makes this project unique is that clients can obtain reliable information from a single platform, which was developed in a market-oriented research facility, making it a one-stop shop for licensed producers and investors.

Name: Fundamental Systems
Description:
All life consists of a body with a microbiome that absorbs food and water and excretes residual substances. We are also all part of the same water system. What one organism excretes affects what the other organism takes in. And that directly affects the balance and effectiveness of the microbiome. Unhealthy stressors such as bacteria, fungi, chemicals and toxins cause oxidative imbalance.

We focus on balancing regulated water systems with hydrogen and oxygen infused water. This invites good bacteria and other complementary organisms into the microbiome. In addition, it is an antioxidant.

We make infused water with our forced dilution technology. This is water with dissolved hydrogen and oxygen molecules that can be absorbed directly. In addition, nano particles allow us to add more hydrogen and oxygen and allow the molecules to travel further. We can also enrich the water by dissolving other gases and liquids such as CO2, bases and acids.

The use of hydrogen and oxygen infused water is beneficial for the health of people, animals and plants. It also creates a self-cleaning water system that is in balance and can be made circular. 

Curious to learn more?
Visit our website or contact us!

Name: RhineGene
Description:
RhineGene is a multi-national biotechnology company which has a rapidly growing distribution, training and service network focused exclusively on molecular diagnostics. Based in the Netherlands, RhineGene currently has offices in four countries and continues its global expansion.

Unique product portfolio, including more than 350 Real-Time PCR kits, covers a wide range of applications for detection, quantitation and genotyping of pathogens, identification and screening of genetic disorders as well as food safety parameters.

RhineGene provides turnkey solutions with instruments including automated nucleic acid extraction robots and Real-Time PCR detection systems with absolute dedication to performance and quality.

Name: ICAI TAI-MRI Lab
Description: The research of Trustworthy AI for Magnetic Resonance Imaging (TAIMRI) Lab aims to improve the accuracy and reduce the costs of MRI-based diagnosis using AI methods, with a focus on neurological and musculoskeletal diseases. TAIMRI Lab is a collaboration between Erasmus MC, General Electric Healthcare, and the Erasmus University of Rotterdam.

Name: IS-Diagnostics Ltd.
Description:
IS-diagnostics is a young company focusing on a new generation of clinical diagnostics. We combine cutting-edge IT solutions with innovative chemistry to fully characterize human and product-related microbiota.

At IS-Diagnostics, we developed a straightforward method to profile the bacterial microflora on all parts of the human body and we are discovering its connection to our health. Our proprietary technique, IS-pro, enables us to reliably characterize complex communities of bacteria. The high level of standardisation of the entire process combined with an novel type of internal control guarantees highly accurate results.

Name: DULISCO (Dutch Life Sciences Cöoperatie UA)
Description: It is our mission to maximize the full potential of our companies with the ultimate goal to improve treatment of patients. Professionalization, broadening of horizons, expansion of networks and experience are key in this. By joining forces and onboard crucial knowledge in the field of business, intellectual property, finance and marketing and communication we are collaboratively accelerating life sciences.

Name: SMIVET
Description: Smivet is a veterinary biotech company focused on developing biotherapeutics to treat diseased animals. The single-domain antibody (SDA) technology is best suited to pursue this purpose. The SDA technology was discovered in the 1990’s in Belgium and further developed for human medicine. Smivet has translated and adapted the technology to make it fit for purpose for animal health. The SDA technology provides better developability traits for multiple species products compared to alternative species-specific platforms. The attractiveness of SMIVET’s SDA platform for Serum Half-Life Extension (SHLE) is the use of a single SHLE SDA across multiple species without major adaptations (Harmsen, Ackerschott and De Smit, 2024). By doing so we overcome the need to pursue species specific products as required for other platforms. Applications Potential product areas are both infectious disease targets and non-infectious chronic disease targets. The first product to be delivered is an SDA that neutralizes a deadly bacterial toxin (De Smit et al. 2021).

Name: Bionatin
Description:
At BioNatIn we believe that bovine colostrum and dairy enzymes play an essential role in the food chain. A sustainable use for bovine colostrum and  all valuable enzymes and proteins it possesses.

BioNatIn is the only Dutch producer of colostrum powder and related products. We believe that personal service, years of experience, high-tech production facilities and trusted suppliers are key in helping our clients all over the world.

Name: ExpediteBio
Description:
ExpediteBio aims to transform antibody and protein therapeutics development through innovative, standardized, and scalable processing solutions, eliminating CMC barriers and fast-tracking life-changing therapies to patients. 

Through our efficient and scalable development platform, we reduce time-to-clinic from years to months across the global biotechnology ecosystem.

Name: BiomACS
Description:
BiomACS stands for Biomaterial Advanced Cell Screening. We are driving innovation in the medical industry with a unique screening platform capable of studying interactions between medical materials and cells. By identifying optimal surface properties, we accelerate the development of advanced medical materials.

BiomACS' technology consists of a unique, proprietary screening platform capable of performing thousands of experiments simultaneously in a semi-automated manner, using relevant tissue cells on a specific material surface. The technology enables detailed analysis of how cells respond to different surface properties, thereby identifying the most optimal properties. The technology was developed at the University of Groningen and the University Medical Center Groningen within the Department of Biomedical Engineering.

BiomACS is dedicated to improving the quality of medical implants and devices. We focus on one of the biggest challenges in the medical implant industry: secondary complications in patients such as excessive scarring or inadequate adhesion to surrounding tissue.

Our mission is to enhance patient safety and increase the effectiveness of medical implants and devices. By collaborating with leading medical and technological partners, we aim to develop innovative solutions that lead to a better quality of implants and devices.

Name: Groningen Microbiome Hub
Description: We integrate large-scale population metagenomics with advanced culturomics and experimental models to decode host-microbe interactions. By leveraging the unique Lifelines biobank, our interdisciplinary teams of bioinformaticians, clinicians, and microbiologists work to identify microbial drivers of health and disease. Our mission is to translate high-dimensional "meta-omic" data into targeted microbiome-based diagnostics and precision therapies.

Name: Genova Genomic Research Center
Description: We empower biomedicine with big data science technology to accelerate cancer research.

Name: Nano Fiber Matrices B.V.
Description: Nano Fiber Matrices B.V. (Nano-FM) provides cell culture matrix solution for assay development and tissue engineering purposes. Nano-FM's ArtiCYT products and services allow researchers to get the best results from their cells/tissues using tailor-made matrices to fit their specific needs.

Name: Chondropeptix
Description: Chondropeptix is a biotechnology company developing peptide-based drugs to stimulate cartilage regeneration in joints of patients with cartilage defects, such as osteoarthritis or focal cartilage defects.

Name: Mills Nutrients & Substrates
Description:
Mills is self-made and 100% Dutch. The pioneer and scientific adventurer with a no-nonsense can-do mentality. We offer a wide range of unique patented plant nutrition formulas and substrates that help growers - from all over the world - to produce 
high quality products and rich harvests with great ease. We make it better by keeping it simple.

Name: Siere Handel B.V.
Description:
Siere Handel was founded in 1997. Our main business activity is focused on the import & export of young plants produced by using tissue culture. Through our exclusive producers in China, we offer our customers a wide assortment of tissue-cultured plants, and are able to accommodate for needs of clients elsewhere with quality tissue culture plants that are price competitive. Customers are also most welcome to assign a mass micro-propagation project to us based on a production contract.
Since the establishment of our company, we have developed long-term, stable business relationship with more than 100 companies throughout the world. While the trading among whole Europe, USA and China, remains to be an important part of our business, our network has expanded to Canada, Japan, as well as Australia, New Zealand, and we continue to explore new business opportunities.

Name: Xambika Biotech
Description: Xambika combines advanced molecular diagnostics and clinical governance to clarify the role of the womb lining in pregnancy loss or implantation failure. Our PRELI test translates complex endometrial signals into actionable insights, helping fertility specialists deliver more targeted, evidence-based treatment strategies.

Name: FerMentor
Description:
FerMentor implements science into daily fermentation practice. Key focus areas are:

► Microbial Physiology   ► Food and Health   ► Technology   ► Sustainability

Application areas include Food and Pharma and customers range from multinationals to start-ups.

Activities / Track record over the last 20+years:

    Discovery of microbes from natural niches, strain collections, and challenged mixed populations. Targetted benefits/applications include Probiotics, LBP’s (live biotherapeutic products), Post-biotics, enzyme production, viscosity and vitamin production.

    Process development of fermentation processes for (strict) anaerobic microbes, starting from medium design, screening, optimisation to small and large scale (industrial) fermentations.

    Trouble shooting fermentation processes including DSP. Microbial biomass production, enzymatic conversions, and dairy plants.

    Product development in dairy, Foods related to the Protein Transition, formulation of bacterial powders.

    Training and workshops. In company, academic and other lectures, but also hands on food fermentation workshops.

Name: BioAg Europe
Description: BioAg Europe bestaat uit een team van specialisten in het winnen van natuurlijke humus(zuur) en fulvinezuur producten voor de agrarische sector, hoveniers en de industrie. Naast het verstrekken van deze unieke producten, heeft BioAg Europe ook als doel de bekendheid van humus- en fulvinezuur in algemene zin te kunnen vergroten.

Name: I-DireCT, Marie Curie Innovative Training Network (ITN)
Description:
The mission of I-DireCT is to provide training and carry out breakthrough research on the rapidly expanding and high impact field of cancer immunotherapy in a carefully integrated academic and inter-sectoral programme.
I-DireCT is a Marie Curie Innovative Training Network (ITN) funded by the European Union within the H2020 Programme. The project is an European Industrial Doctorate (EID) Programme which aims to especially promote the exchange between the academic and the non-academic sector. I-DireCT is a training network aiming to develop next-generation immunotherapeutics and to deliver a set of early stage researchers uniquely qualified for a career in academia and/or industry.

Current immunomodulatory antibodies that target pivotal immune checkpoints that remove the brake from T cell immunity have revolutionized the field of oncology. Further, antibodies that provide co-stimulation to T cells also have entered clinical trials. However, off-tumor activity limits their application. The objective of I-DireCT is to address this issue by

developing innovative bispecific antibodies and immunocytokines with tumor-restricted immunostimulatory effects and
developing optimized delivery systems to ensure optimal timed release of bio-active drug.
Hereto, I-DireCT combines state-of-the-art industrial design of nanotech-based drug formulations with innovative academic and industrial immunotherapeutic concepts into the next-generation of cancer immunotherapeutics. At the core of I-DireCT is its training objective to offer a cutting-edge multidisciplinary training programme that will enable outstanding young scientists to generate breakthrough ideas and assume leading positions in academia and industry. This training programme includes an array of disciplines, ranging from biomedical sciences (e.g. immunology, antibody engineering) and physical sciences (e.g. chemistry, material science) to drug design & development. Industrial partners are central to the programme and provide

Name: 1NA
Description:
1NA is a start-up dedicated to the advancement of DNA Curtains, a technology conceived by Prof. Eric C. Greene at Columbia University, which presents a novel method for analyzing protein-DNA interactions, distinguished by its capability to amass thousands of data points within one measurement, marking a pivotal shift in high-throughput research.

The objective of 1NA is to make this technology available to users from academic laboratories to broader biotech and pharmaceutical sectors.

Name: Mair Therapeutics
Description: Mair Therapeutics is a preclinical-stage drug discovery company focused on the discovery and development of a small-molecule ion channel activator to treat Parkinson's disease.

Name: Ardent Biopharma
Description:
Recent advancements in Continuous Manufacturing (CM), artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) and anticipated regulatory shifts—such as the potential waiver of Phase III clinical trials—have paved the way for a new biosimilar development and manufacturing company. Ardent Biopharma is seizing this opportunity to redefine cost efficiency in the production of monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and other therapeutic proteins.

Leveraging these innovations, we aim to deliver biosimilars below 20% of the originator price, significantly improving global affordability and accessibility to life-saving or life-enhancing biologic therapies. Ardent aspires to become a cost leader in the biosimilars industry. Both first and second wave biosimilars will be developed. 

Development will be done in close collaboration with our partners until we can operate from a proprietary facility in The Netherlands. Future product M&S will be realized through specialized parties per region.

Name: Lumento Therapeutics
Description: Lumento Therapeutics is a biotechnology company dedicated to improving the lives of cancer patients through development of light-activatable cancer drugs.

Name: Logic Chemie
Description:
Logic Chemie delivers advanced, bio-based solutions for waterproofing, structural strengthening, and surface protection.

Operating across 22 countries in Europe and the Middle East, we support construction and infrastructure professionals with high-performance, sustainable technologies.

Powered by Pico Technology, our systems penetrate deep into material pores while remaining breathable, ensuring long-term durability and performance.

- Waterproof yet breathable
-  Multi-surface solutions
-  Up to 20-year guarantee


Headquartered in the Netherlands. Engineered in Germany.

 Partners & Distributors

We are expanding our international network and welcome distributors and partners.

- Market-ready products
- Technical & marketing support
- Long-term collaboration

Let’s grow together. Connect with us.
