Name: CyanO2
Description: CyanO2 is student led project in Eindhoven Univeristy of Technology investigating and upscaling a new way of carbon capture: cyanobacteria bioreactors.

Name: Biochem Products becomes VievePharm – Animal Nutrition
Description: Biochem Products is a Dutch private enterprise that contributes to the reduction of antibiotics in the livestock farming industry. Biochem Products develops and manufactures products that improve animal health and productivity in a sustainable way. Essential oils, plant extracts and vitamins are the basis of all our products.

Name: ZF-screens B.V.
Description: The mission of ZF-screens is to develop products for pharmaceutical applications in the field of fish fertility and compound screening. The unique combination of expertise in both Fish Physiology and MolecularCell Biology makes ZF-screens distinctive in this expanding market.

Name: Saillant Therapeutics
Description: An innovative biotechnology start-up that develops promising small molecule-based therapies against acute ischemic stroke, heart failure (HF) and Alzheimer’s disease.

Name: Fruitin
Description:
Worldwide, around 50 % of the fruit and vegetable production is wasted on a yearly basis.
Fruitin aims to tackle these issues by increasing the shelf-life of fruits and vegetables, through creating an environmental and consumer friendly way of conserving fresh produce.

Name: Aziflu
Description:
Aziflu is a biotech start-up developing a novel class of antiviral small molecules targeting influenza, including both seasonal and pandemic strains. Our compounds are designed to overcome current limitations in antiviral therapy, including resistance and reduced efficacy against emerging variants.

By leveraging a unique approach based on covalent inhibition of viral neuraminidases, Aziflu aims to deliver more potent and durable antiviral solutions.

Follow us to stay updated or get in touch to explore collaborations.

Name: Aristi Biotech B.V.
Description: Aristi Biotech is a Dutch contract research provider specialized in early antibody research and development activities. Aristi has a license to the CHOBC platform to generate high quality and high titre manufacturing cell lines.

Name: The Cheese Design LLC
Description:
Hello there!
We are The Cheese Design, an R&D company that supports manufacturers in the development and manufacturing of fermented foods.
Our long expertise, creativity, and extensive tech network support ambitious organizations that bring fermented foods to the market.
Fermentation is a complex technology, especially in the context of novel foods and can be overwhelming if not approached right.
If your organization is facing challenges with the process,
don't wait - contact us.

Name: Tandrup Water Solutions Nederland B.V.
Description:
Tandrup Water Solutions Nederland verzorgt de verkoop en distributie van filterproducten die geproduceerd worden door het in 1946 opgerichte Deense Tandrup. Wij richten ons op het ontwerpen en produceren van legionellaveilige oplossingen voor al uw high-risk tappunten. Het T-Safe merk is opgezet om een point-of-use filtersysteem te ontwikkelen dat geen afbreuk doet aan het gebruikscomfort en toch veilig is. 

Onze inspanningen om water te besparen hebben ertoe geleid dat wij veel ervaring hebben met het ontwerpen van producten die veel comfort geven bij minimaal waterverbruik. Dit is essentieel gebleken om de levensduur van onze filters te verlengen. 

De verkoop van de Tandrup filterproducten gebeurt via gespecialiseerde dealers. Wilt u in contact komen met een dealer, of heeft u vragen of opmerkingen over onze producten en diensten? Aarzel dan niet om contact met ons op te nemen.

Name: PERSUASIVE Dx
Description: Persuasive B.V. is a young spin-off company licensing technology from the University Medical Center Utrecht. In collaboration with UMCU, Persuasive is developing an innovative diagnostic blood test for early detection of stable angina in chest pain patients. The team is working towards a revolutionary platform technology for high-throughput analysis of extracellular vesicles.

Name: Plant Cytometry Services
Description:
Plant Cytometry Services (PCS) is an independent company specialized in determining the amount of nuclear DNA in plant cells, by using flow cytometry. The company is based in Kapel-Avezaath Buren in the Netherlands and is owned by Dr. Ir. C.J.J.M (Krit) Raemakers. Plant Cytometry Services was founded by Ir. Gerard J.J. Geenen in April 1987 and Krit Raemakers took over the company in 2014.

PCS has cooperated with over 500 companies, research institutes and universities, from all over the world, in the field of plant breeding, plant multiplication and biotechnology. Throughout the years the company has become very experienced with a large range of plant species from all  climatic zones. This includes not only species from the field of agriculture and  horticulture, but also species from nature.

Since August 2014, the company is managed by  Dr. Ir. C.J.J.M. (Krit) Raemakers. Krit is very experienced in the field of plant breeding and horticulture, having done his PHD at the University of Wageningen. After his PhD he worked on the development of tissue culture protocols in a large number of crops, first at Wageningen University and later at a commercial company. Name: CureQ Consortium
Description:
In various hereditary brain diseases, a mutated protein damages brain cells, resulting in health decline, limitations, and death. There is hope with some experimental therapies that can inhibit the production or toxic effects of these proteins. A consortium of organizations has received a €4.7 million grant from NWO to research and develop these treatments, with additional contributions of €0.8 million.

This includes Huntington’s disease, Spinocerebellar Ataxia (SCA) type 1, and SCA type 3. These hereditary diseases are caused by a similar DNA error, leading to the production of a diseased protein. The diseases can occur at a relatively young age and often rapidly lead to significant limitations.

Experimental Treatments

To date, there are no treatments that stop the diseases or slow the decline. Recent promising research has begun with experimental treatments, via spinal taps or a single administration in the brain, to inhibit the production of disease-causing proteins. But before these treatments can be safely and effectively applied, several important questions must be answered, such as:

When is the optimal time to start treatment?
Who will benefit from these therapies, and can we better predict the onset and progression of the disease for each patient individually?
Can we develop alternative therapeutic strategies to lower the harmful protein, preferably with a less invasive administration?
How can we assist gene carriers in making personal decisions about life planning and treatment options?
Collaborative Effort

To address all these questions in a coherent study (named CureQ), various organizations decided to collaborate. Researchers and physicians from various Dutch universities, different HBO programs, ethicists, biotechnology companies, patient associations, and the Proefdiervrij Foundation will work together in this study, aiming to enable a personalized approach and treatment for Huntington’s and SCAs.

Description:
At Bombi, we aim to solve some of today’s most difficult therapeutic challenges; fighting bacterial resistance while safeguarding the skin's microbiome while treating inflammatory skin disorders caused by bacterial infection.

Since the rise in multi-drug resistant skin infections seems unstoppable, alternative strategies to combat these pathogens are of high unmet need.  Our platform is based on broad-spectrum antimicrobial peptides derived from the skin secretion of the Oriental fire-bellied toad (Bombina orientalis) which are then further conjugated to a bacterial recognition domain, also known as "species-specific quorum sensing peptide motifs" which can either be designed to target gram-negative or gram-positive bacteria, or even fungi. 

The resulting linear peptides are further enhanced by N-terminus palmitoylation in order to provide conformational stability, binding potency/selectivity, and increase their antibacterial activity. 

The killing moiety of the resulting fusion peptides are redesigned by modifying electrostatic attractions between cationic peptide molecules and anionic lipids of the bacterial membrane, thereby causing a discriminant and targeted bactericidal effect via a species-specific receptor-mediated pathway.

Our engineering strategy ultimately results in the generation of novel fusion peptides that are switched from being less-specific broad-spectrum to highly selective with increased potency and biofilm penetration properties.

Illuminature is a Dutch biomaterials technology company developing mycelium-based alternatives to fossil-based plastics for horticulture. 
Our first product is a biodegradable plant pot, grown in days from local agricultural residual streams and fungal mycelium. 
The pot is designed to meet the operational demands of professional horticulture: performance under real-world growing conditions, compatibility with existing machinery, and a clean return to soil at end of life.

Beyond manufacturing, our facilities support collaborative R&D partnerships — giving clients a place to develop, test, and scale new fermentation-based products efficiently. From early-stage formulation to commercial production, we work alongside our partners as an extension of their team.

At WHC Lab Group, we're empowering the future of fermentation — through science, innovation, and collaboration.

With the expanding database and experience in testing more than 38.000 different strains, we are striving to create the most complete and most efficient catalog of strains tested on a global scale and this cross referenced with patient evaluation forms and trials that are available for medical research and education. Name: Vascular Research LUMC
Description: The vascular research laboratory at the Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC) is a translational research group with an interest in vascular biology and in particular, the pathophysiology behind atherosclerosis and vein graft disease. To better understand the pathophysiology and molecular and cellular mechanisms occurring in the vessel wall, state-of-the-art imaging technologies such as photoacoustics are employed. Furthermore, the lab has conducted extensive research on the role of the innate as well as the adaptive immune system and intraplaque angiogenesis. Besides the various original studies that are conducted, the group also aims to teach the next generation of researchers by offering multiple options for internships and PhD-projects.

Name: PsyPhy
Description:
At PsyPhy, our mission is to revolutionize neuroscientific education and research by providing accessible and innovative solutions. We are dedicated to empowering students, educators, and researchers with cutting-edge neuroimaging technologies, comprehensive educational platforms, and exceptional support. By bridging the gap between theory and practice, we strive to inspire curiosity, deepen understanding, and unlock the full potential of neuroscientific exploration. Our mission is driven by a commitment to excellence, innovation, and the advancement of knowledge for the betterment of individuals and society as a whole.

We specialize in developing innovative EEG (Electroencephalography) solutions and neurophysiological experimental tools. We provide affordable and accurate neuroimaging equipment, enabling individuals to record and analyze EEG, EMG, EOG, GSR, and ECG data, fostering a deeper understanding of the human mind.

Name: Oceans Unlocked
Description:
Why is the ocean so important to reach the Sustainable Development Goals?
Well, that's actually pretty simple.... 70 % of the earth's surface exists of water, 97 % of which is salt water. Just imagine.. that's a lot, right? However, only 2% of our resources come from the sea. In other words, the oceans' aquatic flora and fauna offer an immense potential.

We believe that unlocking the potential of the oceans in a sustainable manner is an essential part of climate action. This is why we created Oceans Unlocked. Oceans Unlocked is the parent company of SeaFlavours International, Green Marine Farming, and Blue Wave BioTech.

How do we work towards our mission?

We process fish by products to extract high quality ingredients for food, aquafeed, cosmetics, and pharma. (Blue Wave BioTech)

We offer premium fresh and dried seaweed, and seaweed salads, accelerating the transition to European sustainable seaweed production. (SeaFlavours International)

Interested? Drop us a line - we look forward to meeting you!

We are currently active in Europe (mostly Benelux and Spain, and exporting to Germany and Poland) and Asia (mostly China) but we are starting to expand to other geographical areas.

As Bion, we strongly promote a strategy, culture and management style focused on sustainable development and sales in the three end-user segments. Name: U-CyTech biosciences
Description:
Founded in 1999 and headquartered in Utrecht, the Netherlands, U-CyTech biosciences is a biotechnology company dedicated to advancing both fundamental and applied research in cytokine biology.

Known for its open-door culture and long-standing customer relationships, U-CyTech specializes in ELISA and T and B cell ELISPOT assays for the ex vivo detection of individual protein-secreting cells. We also develop an extensive portfolio of highly specific monoclonal antibodies against a broad range of cytokines, forming the foundation of our highly sensitive ELISA, ELISPOT, and FluoroSpot assays.

Our mission is to provide researchers worldwide with reliable, innovative tools that support breakthroughs in immunology and life sciences.

We offer a total solution for eDNA analyses addressing ecological questions and (swimming) water quality. Since 2018, we offer possibilities for the isolation and analysis of eDNA using our kits in other laboratories. For this purpose, we have developed complete kits for the sampling, isolation, and analysis of eDNA samples. These kits have been fully validated for robustness, detection limit, efficiency, and repeatability. We also provide full support in setting up an eDNA laboratory and offer comprehensive eDNA courses for personnel.

Name: Fibriant BV
Description: Fibrinogen, a natural soluble blood protein, is at the heart of Fibriant’s science, technology and products. The conversion of Fibrinogen, by active Thrombin, into the insoluble Fibrin matrix is a pivotal step in hemostasis, tissue repair and host-defense against infections. In nature Fibrinogen and Fibrin appear in different forms, each form with a specific and unique structure-function profile. This variation in form and function provides Fibriant with many opportunities to create new and improved, customized healthcare solutions based on specific variants of human Fibrinogen and Fibrin. Fibriant has developed a recombinant manufacturing platform to produce different variants of human Fibrinogen as well as active human Thrombin.

Name: ASPYR Biomanufacturing
Description:
At ASPYR, we look to harness the infinite potential of microalgae, especially Spirulina, to biomanufacture products for nutrition and for food security.  As a B2B social entrepreneurial venture, we look to provide penetrative nutritional products at highly affordable prices to projects, organizations, and humanitarian aid agencies, to help improve nutritional access and standards in regions of extensive malnutrition across Asia and Africa.  To counterbalance this, we also look to commercialize products for the food and beverage, pharmaceutical, and cosmetic industries.

Name: Innosieve Diagnostics BV
Description:
Innosieve Diagnostics BV is a biotechnology company specializing in delivering "Rapid Microbial Methods" for diagnostic purposes. Their primary focus is on providing innovative solutions for microbiological assays with high reliability, designed for fast and simple use. The company has in-house development specialists who have created techniques and translated them into user-friendly assays suitable for rapid, routine, on-site analysis, both within and outside laboratory environments.
One of Innosieve Diagnostics' notable technologies is the MuScan technology, which relies on solid-phase cytometry with fluorescence. This technology allows for direct and rapid microbial analysis, enabling the detection and quantification of microbes within just one hour from sample to result, without the need for microbial enrichment. Innosieve has also developed CFR21Part11 supportive software for image analysis and data presentation and evaluation.
The company's products, including hardware, software, and assays, have been successfully commercialized and are utilized by a variety of industrial customers. 
In summary, Innosieve Diagnostics BV specializes in rapid method development, particularly in the field of microbiological diagnostics, and combines this expertise with image analysis. They offer a range of products aimed at simplifying and accelerating microbial analysis for various applications.

Name: BunyaVax
Description: BunyaVax exploits proprietary vaccine platform technology to develop safe and efficacious vaccines against infectious diseases and cancer. The unique ‘Plug and Play’ platforms are used to generate potent vaccines that can encode almost any antigen of interest. Applications are in the veterinary and human setting.

Name: EuroGenomics Cooperative U.A.
Description: The EuroGenomics Cooperative was created in April 2016 after a 6 year period of strong collaboration on the field of data-sharing. It gathers 7 members (AI and breeders organizations) from 8 countries: Denmark, Finland, Sweden, Spain, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium and France. The aim is to promote a reliable cattle breeding in Europe by sharing data and encouraging further collaboration in the field of genomic selection.

Name: PLaN Therapeutics
Description:
We bring an affordable treatment for heart muscle disease PLN from the lab to the patient. We do this in close collaboration with the PLN Foundation. The foundation's goal is to find an affordable treatment for the disease as quickly as possible. We join in by getting this possible treatment to the patient.

Calcium ions in the heart muscle cells are important for our heart to beat. The protein phospholamban (PLN) plays an important role in the calcium metabolism of heart muscle cells. In 2010, a mutation (change in DNA) in the PLN gene was linked to the development of heart muscle disease in the Netherlands. The Dutch mutation concerns the absence of the amino acid arginine (Arg) at position 14 and is therefore called in scientific terms: PLN p.Arg14del (1).

Our job is to bring scientific breakthroughs from the lab to the patient. For us, this means: developing an affordable treatment for PLN. We work closely with the foundation for research into these new treatments. The work that comes next is our responsibility.

No longer bound to the treatment restrictions imposed due to patient and tumor heterogeneity, NUAgo's short RNAs offer the promise shift to potentially shift cancer therapy toward a chronic-like condition with periods of complete response or tumor elimination. Name: Laboratory of Pediatrics, Beatrix Children's Hospital UMCG NL

To achieve our mission we have four major goals:

* Fundamental and Applied Research aimed at understanding molecular principles of metabolic health and mechanisms underlying the development of inborn and acquired metabolic diseases

* Accelerating Translational Research to convert novel insights into improved diagnostics and/or effective prevention and treatment strategies

* Advanced Teaching, to educate the next generation of (bio)medical professionals

Description:
At Caelus Life Sciences, we're redefining how we treat and prevent diseases. By unlocking the incredible potential of the gut microbiome, we're crafting precision probiotics that take on big health challenges—including autoimmune diseases, cardiometabolic conditions, and cancers. 

Founded by award-winning scientists, we’ve been pushing boundaries with innovative microbiome research since 2014. Now, we're getting ready to launch our first product, a natural, evidence-based, and clinically proven probiotic for prediabetes and type 2 diabetes.

Name: MycoSafe
Description:
Globally, 20% of all food and feed — including beverages — is lost to fungal spoilage, while multi-drug resistance in fungal pathogens continues to rise. Current preservation measures rely on energy-intensive processes like pasteurization, or chemical additives such as sulfites and benzoates which are known allergens. Increasing demand for clean-label products and the EU’s push for net-zero emissions by 2050 create a growing need for natural, eco-friendly alternatives. Concomitantly, alternatives to antifungal antibiotics currently used in clinical therapy and livestock farming are urgently needed. 

MycoSafe aims to develop and market mycocins — small proteins secreted by yeasts to eliminate competitors — as innovative biocontrol agents for food, beverages, and agriculture. Supported by Biotech Booster, we are building a yeast-based production platform to produce mycocins for versatile, industrial-scale applications. 

Our first application targets the preservation of non-alcoholic beer, a beverage particularly prone to contamination by spoilage yeasts that ferment residual sugars into alcohol — posing health risks and liability issues. Mycocins can neutralize these spoilage yeasts effectively and are easy to apply, helping large brewers reduce energy use and allowing small breweries to avoid costly equipment. Our mission is to harness the power of mycocins to create a safer, greener brewing industry — and drive the future of sustainable food and beverage preservation.

The Bio4Products project has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under grant agreement No. 723070.

Innovative biomass conversion
Bio4Products will demonstrate an innovative two-step conversion method based on thermal fractionation. Treatment by fast pyrolysis will first convert the solid biomass into a bio-oil, while largely preserving the original functionalities. The next step sees the functional groups present in the bio-oil separated by fractionation, obtaining a sugar stream and a lignin stream. A fractionation demo-plant will be constructed by BTG Biomass Technology group at their facility in the Netherlands.

New bio-based products 
Bio4Products will create renewable and natural alternatives to fossil-based processing streams such as bitumen, phenols and creosote. Partners will demonstrate the integration of these sustainable resources into four end products: 
1. roofing material
2. phenolic resins 
3. sand moulding resins 
4. engineered wood and natural fibre reinforced products

The overall objective is to create four products, which, due to the replacement of fossil materials with bio-based resources, deliver a 75% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions.

Description:
ROBOX: Expanding the industrial use of Robust Oxidative Biocatalysts for the conversion and production of alcohols.
_________________________
Follow us: https://twitter.com/ROBOX_Enzymes
http://www.h2020robox.eu/
_________________________
Today’s quest for environmentally friendly and sustainable alternatives requires that traditional chemical processes are replaced by “greener” variants. Current industrial conversions are typically performed under harsh conditions (high temperature and pressure), requiring often toxic chemicals and generate hazardous by products. Enzymes have emerged as powerful alternatives to replace chemical catalysts or as a basis for potential biotechnological applications. 

Oxygen functionalities are key functional groups in many of today’s chemicals and materials. The efficient introductions of oxygen-functionalities into raw materials are key chemical transformations in bulk and fine chemicals. Innovative bio-catalytic oxidation routes using molecular oxygen (from air) under benign and mild (pH) conditions such as ambient temperature and pressure can greatly improve the sustainability and economics of processes, but are so far mainly been applied in the pharma segments. In this segment, the enzyme-catalyzed step often represents the highest added value and the high price of the end-product (> €1000/kg) justifies less than optimal enzyme production and limitations in its catalytic efficiency. In order to achieve the widening of industrial application of enzymatic bio-oxidation processes to also larger volume but lower price chemical markets, ROBOX will demonstrate the techno-economic viability of bio-transformations of four types of robust oxidative enzymes: P450 monooxygenases (P450s), Baeyer-Villiger MonoOxygenase (BVMOs), Alcohol DeHydrogenase (ADH) and Alcohol OXidase (AOX) for which target reactions have already been validated on lab-scale in pharma, nutrition, fine & specialty chemicals and materials applications.

Established in 1995, the EUROFUNG network stands as a prominent European hub of expertise with globally recognized specialists and long-standing collaborations between industry and academia in the field of white biotechnology. Name: DyMiCo - Clean and Living Water
Description:
DyMiCo is short for Dynamic Mineral Control, a filtration technology that responds dynamically to your aquarium, maintaining all seawater minerals in balance. DyMiCo filtration is based on natural principles, where bacteria, plankton and reef animals all work together to create a food web, just like on a real coral reef.

In contrast to conventional technologies such as protein skimmers, DyMiCo does not filter the water heavily, allowing for a natural plankton population to grow. This plankton includes bacteria, algae (phytoplankton) and crustaceans (zooplankton), and lies at the basis of a healthy coral reef.

DyMiCo actively breaks down nutrients, which can become toxic to aquarium life and act as fertilizer for algae. These nutrients are ammonium, nitrite, nitrate and phosphate.

In the top layer of the DyMiCo reactor, or sand bed, ammonium (NH +) is first oxidized to nitrite (NO2), and subsequently to nitrate (NO3).

In the lower layer of the sand bed, nitrate is reduced to dinitrogen gas (N2), which is then slowly released into the aquarium water. Eventually, aeration of the seawater causes dinitrogen gas to be released into the atmosphere, just like in nature.

In addition, DyMiCo actively releases alkaline earth metals into your aquarium, known as calcium  (Ca2+) and magnesium (Mg2+), in addition to carbonates (HCO3 , CO3) which provide buffer capacity.

Het levert warmte en hoge kwaliteit compost!, welke bijdraagt aan een gezonde, vruchtbare en watervasthoudende bodem. Reststromen worden verwerkt en de natuurlijk kringloop gesloten. Er wordt zo positief bijgedragen aan verschillende maatschappelijke opgaven, namelijk: 
de landbouw transitie; 
het vasthouden van water en stimuleren van biodiversiteit;
en met dezelfde hoeveelheid biomassa wordt de bijdrage aan de klimaatopgave, tot wel 2 maal zo groot! Door koolstofopslag in de bodem met de compost en de warmteopbrengst.

Name: CVENT H2020
Description:
CVENT: European Union’s Horizon 2020 programme
Risk assessment of plaque rupture and future cardiovascular events by multi-spectral photoacoustic imaging

Vulnerable atherosclerotic carotid plaques, an age and lifestyle related vascular disease, remain a major cause of death for men and women at middle age and is also a hallmark of generalized cardiovascular diseases (CVD) involving other critical vascular regions like the coronary arteries. Every patient exhibiting symptoms of partial occlusion of the carotid arteries is examined with ultrasound (US) because a matured carotid plaque is potentially vulnerable to rupture. When that happens, the content of the lesion entering the blood stream can cause stroke. In the EU this affects over 1 million people annually. According to the guidelines, the patient is operated on, if a 70-99% occlusion of the artery is found. However, only one out of nine operations is effective (Barnett 1998; Rothwell 2003). Even worse, 19 operations need to be done to prevent a single stroke. Hence, the current method to assess plaque vulnerability is insufficient.

The existence of intra-plaque haemorrhages is the main indicator of rupture-prone atherosclerotic plaques in general. The revolutionary step forward in functional photoacoustic imaging (PA) to be made by the CVENT consortium is providing in-vivo functional imaging of vulnerable plaques in the carotid artery for screening, in-depth diagnosis and monitoring.

CVENT is focused on CVD patients to screen, diagnose and monitor carotid plaque vulnerability, by stratifying patients into higher and lower risk groups, this leads to a reduction in overtreatment, better allocation of healthcare cost, and thus contribute to the sustainability of the health care system in Europe.

Name: Annogen
Description:
Bespoke promoters and enhancers, for any tissue, any organism.

At Annogen, our vision is a future where safe and effective advanced therapies are specifically expressed in the right tissues with no off-target effects. We believe that this can be achieved by bespoke promoters (genetic switches) and genomic expression sites. 

Therefore, Annogen is on a mission towards becoming the leading expertise center for gene expression engineering in order to improve the safety and effectiveness of tomorrow's cell and gene therapies. 

Annogen leverages its proprietary SuRETM technology to identify regulatory DNA elements to be used for controlled (therapeutic) gene expression for gene & cell therapy, as well as for recombinant protein and virus production. In addition, we develop service projects based on our proprietary AIMTM technology to identify favorable gene insertions and their expression levels for more than 100,000 integrations in parallel. These approaches typically enable big improvements in any biomedical strategy involving the (over-) expression of genes.  

Annogen was founded in 2017 by Dr. Joris van Arensbergen, who developed and published the SuRETM technology as a post-doctoral fellow in the laboratory of Prof. Dr. Bas van Steensel at the world-renowned Netherlands Cancer Institute (NKI). Today, Annogen is the trusted partner for bespoke gene expression engineering for leading biopharmaceutical, agricultural and academic research centers globally.

Description:

SLPimmunotherapies are designed to fully harness and direct the body’s own defenses towards fighting the disease. In December 2017, ISA Pharmaceuticals closed a clinical immuno-oncology collaboration with Regeneron to advance its SLPlead compound ISA101, an immunotherapy targeting human papillomavirus type 16 (HPV16)-induced cancer, in combination with cemiplimab (REGN2810, Libtayo), a PD-1 (programmed cell death protein 1) antibody in development by Regeneron, which was recently approved by the FDA as monotherapy for patients with advanced cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma. ISA develops a diverse SLPimmunotherapy portfolio targeting unmet medical needs in cancer and chronic infections, including tailored therapy for rare diseases.

ISA ́s most advanced clinical-stage immunotherapeutic is ISA101, an SLP immunotherapy targeting human papillomavirus (HPV)-induced diseases. It is currently in clinical development in advanced and recurrent cervical cancer, incurable HPV16-postive solid tumors and anal intraepithelial neoplasia (AIN). Clinical proof-of-concept has been established in vulvar intraepithelial neoplasia (VIN), a pre-cancerous disease caused by HPV.

The company was founded in 2004 by Aglaia Oncology Fund and is based in Leiden, The Netherlands. For more information, please visit www.isa-pharma.com

SLP and AMPLIVANT are registered trademarks in Europe.

Name: Locsense
Description:
Locsense develops and supplies barrier integrity monitoring equipment for early stage research in the pharmaceutical, food and cosmetics industry. 

Our flagship device, the Locsense Artemis, is a non-invasive sensor that monitors cell growth and cell health in conventional transwell plates with inserts. 
Locsense is at the forefront of lab technology with devices that non-invasively monitor and test cells outside the body. In our bodies, cells often form protective barriers. Think of these barriers as tiny walls that separate different areas. For example, the lining of your gut has cells that create a barrier between your food and the rest of your body, or the skin which forms a protective barrier for influences from outside.
Impedance measurements offer a way to measure how strong these barriers are and whether they are intact. The Artemis offers insight into how healthy cell barriers are. This is crucial for drug testing, studying diseases, and making sure our body’s defenses work properly.
Our products are designed to combine with conventional workflow. At the same time they can be coupled to innovative in-vitro cell culture platforms, such as microfluidic chips, organs-on-chip or smartplates.

At SilicoGene, our mission is to make personalized medicine accessible and affordable for all. We provide tools that allow biologists and researchers to build AI-driven workflows using an intuitive, user-friendly interface, making drug discovery and precision healthcare faster and more effective.

Description:
The Holomicrobiome Institute integrates fundamental microbiome research across agriculture, food production, healthcare, and water management, recognizing the need for a holistic approach. 

Leveraging developments in computation and artificial intelligence, it will model and predict microbiome interactions, accelerating the development of applications such as microbial fertilizers, sustainable food ingredients and products, new diagnostic tools, and safer medical treatments.

Name: Hycult Biotech
Description:
Hycult Biotech is a manufacturer of research reagents in the field of innate immunity. Our products are co-developed with researchers around the globe. By connecting science with disease, these products offer innovative research solutions that enable better treatment, monitoring and prevention.

Our focus on innate immunity means we pay special attention to products relating to antimicrobial peptides, complement, acute phase proteins, LPS and microbial toxins.

Hycult Biotech further has a specific interest in inflammation and cell - and tissue damage. We contribute to these areas with our extensive knowledge in the development and production of assays, antibodies and proteins.

Originally a spin-off from the Leiden University Medical Center (LUMC), our mission is to develop and manufacture therapeutic proteins to restore hemostasis. Our lead compound, VMX-C001, is intended to safely and effectively restore hemostasis in case of bleeding or emergency surgery in patients taking so-called oral factor Xa inhibitors. The VarmX program has gained significant interest in the investment community and a very successful Series B financing round of €32 mill. was closed in 2020.
This round was followed by a Series B2 round of €32 mill. in May 2023 allowing the company to further progress the lead program towards Investigational New Drug (IND) approval and prepare for pivotal trials.

Name: Nature's Principles
Description:
Nature's Principles aims to disrupt traditional Agro-chemicals production processes through new fermentation and chemical technologies. 

Our first process produces high grade lactic acid, to be used for biopolymers, green solvents, food/feed and many other applications.

Using proprietary platform technology based on mixed culture fermentation, we are feedstock agnostic and application agnostic, which means we utilize different residual streams on a a low-cost, low-maintenance, easy-to-operate, highly scalable production fermentation method that will then be complemented by refinery process to tackle a specific use case. We are focused on the fermentation step of lactic acid production to unlock the use of 2G residual streams as feedstock on the large scale. 

Our core values are integrity, empathy, accountability and sustainability. We believe traditional processes and products need to be disrupted to enable local industries with energy and CO2-neutral production. In 2030, we hope to enable cost-competitive PLA production, where PLA can compete with crude oil products such as polystyrene and polypropylene on price and quality, whilst capturing CO2.

We are open for partnerships. Check in with us to start a conversation on how we can create a world were biodiversity, human and environmental needs coexist in a balanced way.

In the Benelux, CST represents New England Biolabs (NEB), offering a broad range of molecular biology reagents including enzymes, cloning and expression tools, and purification kits. By combining the expertise of CST in protein and cell biology with the leadership of NEB in molecular biology, we provide researchers with complementary solutions for every step of their workflow, from DNA to protein.

Advanced 4 in 1 Camera Systems for Plant Phenotyping

Color imaging for growth and morphology
Multispectral imaging for detailed plant traits
Chlorophyll fluorescence imaging for photosynthesis efficiency

Name: AlgaePARC
Description:
At AlgaePARC, as part of Wageningen University & Research  we work on a large multidisciplinary research program within a fifteen year-roadmap (2010-2025) for industrial algae and cyanobacteria production. In this program both commodities and higher value products are covered. For commodities we focus on reduction of production costs and scale-up while for high values compounds the challenges are on reliability on product quality and quantity and market introduction which requires an increase of product range and volume.

With a multidisciplinary approach, we work on efficient use of resources (light, carbon dioxide, nitrogen and phosphorus) while reducing energy input and recycling nutrients. This is done by developing and optimizing reactor design and process strategies. In parallel to this we study the cell biology to develop robust strains which can accumulate specific products. Techniques on molecular biology, mutagenesis and laboratory evolution are being developed and used. Last but not the least, implementation bridges the fundamental research to applications. We look at process scale-up, biorefinery and chain analysis, with the aim to develop a sustainable production chain.

Name: AZAR Innovations
Description:
We help scientists find out if Organ on a chip technology is something for them! If yes, we then help them adopt the right one. We do this by education and training, research and development, and consulting. We help scientists use organ on a chip systems more easily, more reliably and more reproducibly. We envision a future with better communication and interdisciplinary collaborations towards a great impact on human health.

Our SERVICES:
- Organ on a chip MasterClasses - Lectures and hands-on lab trainings
- Research & development in organ on a chip (we do not re-invent the wheel)
- Consulting biotech industry with organ on a chip systems and trends
- Consulting investors with the organ on a chip industry

Not biased towards a certain technology, we believe in "fit for purpose" organs on chips as tools for life sciences.

Want to get in touch? Email us at NiceToMeetYou@azar-innovations.com or visit our website www.azar-innovations.com

AZAR Innovations is named after Azar Hadisadegh, a kind and caring mother who devoted her life to the good in the world.

Name: Imuno Therapeutics
Description: Imuno is pioneering the power of machine learning to build a structure-based discovery engine to identify cancer-specific epitopes that can be exploited by novel therapeutic strategies. Our discovery engine not only identifies epitopes that are 100% unique to a patient's tumor, it selects those have the best properties for therapeutic targeting.

Name: River BioMedics
Description: We combine our cardiac biology knowhow with our expertise in bio-engineering and human induced pluripotent stem cells (hiPSC) to develop 3D cardiac in vitro models for the discovery and development of novel cardiac drugs.

Name: Seaweedland
Description:
Feeding The World Sustainably 

We cultivate premium seaweed on land using controlled raceway technology. This enables consistent, food-safe and contamination-free production with reliable year-round availability. By moving seaweed cultivation to land-based systems, we remove the unpredictability of weather, pollution and seasonal variability while maintaining full control over quality, traceability and supply.

Seaweed is one of the most promising yet underutilised resources on our planet. It requires no fresh water, no arable land and absorbs CO2 as it grows. Rich in proteins, fibres and minerals, seaweed has strong potential in hybrid meat products, flavour enhancement, dairy innovation and sustainable food applications.

As global demand for sustainable protein continues to rise, Seaweedland provides the scalable cultivation expertise and infrastructure needed to integrate seaweed into mainstream food production.

From pilot production in the Netherlands to international licensing partnerships, we are working to build a resilient and low-impact food value chain for the growing population, and our planet.

Name: QurieGen
Description: QurieGen is a Dutch techbio company building “Google Maps for cells” to derisk and accelerate drug discovery and development. Our secret sauce is the data and models. We generate proprietary single-cell multi-omics data using our in-house built technologies, and we feed this unique, high-resolution dataset into our AI models. This allows us to build mechanistic, interpretable virtual cell models that simulate how signals move through pathways and predict how drugs reshape cellular systems. Because we control both the data layer and the modeling layer, we can go far beyond black-box predictions.

Name: ProteoNic
Description:
ProteoNic is a biotechnology company active in development and licensing of DNA technology for cell line generation and recombinant protein production for pharmaceutical applications. We offer premium vector technology that substantially boosts production levels of therapeutic proteins and other biologics. Cost savings are immediate and sizeable, freeing up production capacity and enabling commercially viable production of difficult to express proteins.

ProteoNic’s 2G UNicTM drives higher production for all types of therapeutic protein products, including monoclonal antibodies, biosimilars and more difficult-to-express (DTE) proteins, such as Fc-fusion proteins and bi-specifics, contributing to their economic viability. Our patented technology does not require modifications to existing production systems or work flows and is compatible with all production cell lines and expression systems used in the industry. Independent technical and commercial validation by third parties, including top tier biopharma, demonstrates severalfold productivity level increases that translate into multi-million Euros in annual cost savings.

 The technology has wide ranging potential to boost production efficiencies in other important applications, including viral vector production, protein production in yeast and technologies which impact product quality.

The company is headquartered at the BioScience Park in Leiden, the Netherlands.

Name: Rodenburg Biopolymers
Description: Discover our activities: Bioplastics | Feed Ingredients | Industrial Ingredients | Extrusion Services | Tony Starch | Side Stream Innovation Valley.

Name: HOOP Project
Description:
The HOOP project supports 8 lighthouse cities & regions in developing large-scale urban circular bioeconomy initiatives that will focus on sustainably obtaining bio-based products from urban biowaste and wastewater. 

The HOOP Urban Circular Bioeconomy Hub will create an online platform to foster knowledge exchange and replication in cities across Europe.
HOOP is a Horizon 2020 project.

Lipor (PT)
The Cluster of Bioeconomy and Environment of Western Macedonia (CLuBE)(EL)
Ayuntamiento de Murcia (ES)
Stadt Münster (DE)

Name: MYCOTEX
Description:
MYCOTEX is a biomaterials technology company engineering next-generation mycelium based materials for real-world products and scalable applications.

Our breakthrough mycelium technology and digital platform development approach, enables companies across interiors, furniture, textiles, fashion, and accessories to create high-performance, sustainable products without complexity.

Designed to integrate into existing or new supply chains, our patented biomaterials unlock unlimited design freedom while reducing environmental impact and accelerating the transition to circular manufacturing.

Name: Pan Cancer T
Description:
Pan Cancer T is a biotechnology spin-out (Erasmus MC, Rotterdam) focussed on the discovery and development of T cell receptor (TCR) T cell therapies. We exploit the 20 years of pioneering in adoptive T cell therapy as a springboard to breakthrough treatment of solid tumors.

Pan Cancer T develops natural affinity TCR T cell therapies towards unique and proprietary intracellular targets expressed by multiple solid tumors, and make T cell therapy maximally accessible despite the tumor micro-environment challenges.

Name: New Dawn Bio
Description:
At New Dawn, we're on a mission to usher in a new era of sustainable living by transforming the way we think about and create wood products. 

 Our Vision:
Imagine a world where we no longer rely on the depletion of forests for wood. That's the world we're working to create. We're pioneering the future of wood production through cutting-edge biotechnology and innovation, inspired by the principles behind cultured meat production: wood that's not cut from trees, but grown from cells.

Name: Suntory Flowers Europe
Description:
We’re Suntory Flowers Europe. We are known for breeding, testing, selecting and introducing new innovative bedding plants of the highest quality within Europe. 
 
Suntory Flowers Europe tests and selects the most innovative and robust summer plants each year. We’ll consider multiple creative qualities such as colour, shape and flowering behaviour. Our plants must be strong, resilient, and resistant to weather circumstances. We also keep the ease of use in mind, as customers desire carefree plants that are easy to maintain and do not require much water. We select the products we introduce based on the previously mentioned attributes and their uniqueness, market potential, and trendiness.
 
Once products are approved for introduction, Suntory Flowers Europe sells the rights to propagate (multiply) the plants to its partners. We work closely together with the biggest propagators, growers and renowned retailers. Suntory Flowers Europe is a true pillar in the flower industry, as we’re the source of many new products in the assortment of bedding plants like Surfinia, Sundaville, Senetti, Princettia, Million Bells & Granvia.
 
Besides introducing new summer plants, we actively support our partners in marketing our products effectively. We build strong consumer brands to convey the supreme quality of our products, increase brand awareness and always be recognisable. This way, our unique brands add value for every stakeholder, from the propagator to the growers, exporters, retailers and eventually the happy end-consumer.

Name: CC Diagnostics
Description: CC Diagnostics aims to market a superior method for diagnosing early stages of cervical cancer. With this accurate test implemented in national cervical cancer screening programs (or sold on the private market), a big part of unneeded follow-up diagnostic can be prevented. As a result, healthcare costs and women’s stress will be reduced. With this method of testing, CC Diagnostics can play its part in making sure there is accurate and participative cervical screening available for every woman.

Name: CleanLight
Description:
CleanLight has developed a wide ranging assortment of UVSanitation equipment. For agriculture, healthcare, hospitality, retail, and transport.
Stop powdery mildew now: https://forms.gle/Gbzzsnq2gYuA2Ymd9

Name: Anavo Therapeutics BV
Description:
Anavo Therapeutics is the first company to systematically drug phosphatases, a rich target space previously considered undruggable for decades. 

We have attracted world-leading scientific expertise in phosphatase-driven disease biology and drug discovery to unlock the full potential of phosphatase-targeted allosteric modulators. In oncology, Anavo is developing multiple first-in-class therapeutic programs and will build on partnerships around its platform to establish a rich pipeline across several indications.

Anavo is backed by blue-chip investors M Ventures, INKEF Capital, Taiho Ventures, and Bioqube Ventures.

Name: Cleara Biotech B.V.
Description:
Cleara is a biopharmaceutical R&D company dedicated to discovery and development of therapies against cancer and chronic diseases through selective elimination of subtypes of cellular senescence.

Through detailed understanding of the molecular and biological pathways that underlie these individual pathological phenotypes, we set up disruptive, innovative and proprietary platform technology to design and optimize (peptide-based) therapeutics that exploit their weak spots for safe and selective clearance. Cleara’s lead FOXO4 program is focused on generation of disruptive and proprietary technology against “scarred” cellular senescence for treatment of metastatic, mutant-p53 cancer.

Senescent cells are associated with a range of chronic diseases and cancer progression. However, Cleara acknowledges that there are different kinds of senescence. We do not focus on “magic bullets” to kill all senescent cells but develop specific and safe compounds against unique subtypes. Cleara’s goal is to progress these into clinical development with the intent of precision medicine against specific diseases with clear niche-directed anti-senescence lead candidates, with associated biomarkers, around its FOXO4-based D-amino acid pipeline.

Name: Kling Biotherapeutics
Description:
Kling Biotherapeutics is a clinical-stage, privately held biotech company focused on discovery and development of antibody based therapeutics. The company is headquartered in Amsterdam, Netherlands with a fully owned IP portfolio that covers platform technologies Kling-Select and Kling-Evolve for the simultaneous discovery of novel targets and identification of fully human antibodies directly from patient-derived B cells.

Kling-Select relies on a fully-owned and well-validated B cell immortalization technology to identify novel therapeutic targets and antibody binders from patients with exceptional clinical responses. This technology has successfully identified novel neutralising antibodies for various infectious diseases such as RSV (Nirsevimab/Beyfortus), Covid, and Influenza. More recently, Kling-Select has been applied to peripheral and tumor-infiltrating B cells derived from cancer patients and produced a portfolio of novel and selective target-antibody pairs. The unbiased nature of this discovery platform allows identification of novel targets and unique epitopes inaccessible to traditional target discovery approaches.

Kling-Evolve enables the in vitro maturation of B cell clones against targets of interest. This powerful technology can be used for the rapid evolution of neutralizing antibodies against emerging viral variants or for affinity and selectivity improvement of oncology assets.

In addition to platform technologies, Kling Biotherapeutics is pursuing asset pipeline programs with KBA1412 currently in phase I, and multiple programs in preclinical development.

Name: Aardaia
Description:
Aardaia is pioneering a new era of domestication on demand, a transformative approach that harnesses the immense, untapped biodiversity of the plant kingdom to create new crops suited for the challenges of the 21st century. 

Aardaia’s flagship crop, the aardaker, is set to revolutionize protein production. This nitrogen-fixing tuber is a high-protein alternative to both legumes and potatoes, with the yield potential of a tuber and the protein density of a legume—a true “protein potato.”

Name: BioFashionTech
Description:
Unlocking Textile Waste's Value | Revolutionizing Sustainability

Say goodbye to textile waste and hello to valuable, sustainable products! At BioFashionTech, we've developed a unique, scalable biotech process that transforms pre and post-consumer textile waste into high-value bio-products.

But that's not all - we go the extra mile by separating out polyester and dyes, creating a closed loop solution. And the best part? Our technology is free from harmful chemistry and can process various materials like cotton, viscose, and poly/cotton blends.

By partnering with us, you're joining a movement that brings 85% of textile waste out of incinerators and landfills and into the realm of circular, biobased products. Not only that, but we're also reducing the need for fossil fuels used in synthetic fiber production, which accounts for a whopping 52% of the global fiber market.

We don't stop there. Through our sister company #Chicfashic, we raise awareness about the fashion industry and empower consumers to make informed choices. 
Together, let's transform the world of fashion and make a sustainable impact, one stylish step at a time.

Name: Gyes BV
Description:
Gyes is using the Multispecific Antibody Platform (the MAP) to discover and develop precision antibody therapeutics. 
Are you an expert in the field of antibody-engineering and drug development and ready to join a team of world-renowned scientists and drug developers, please inquire about job openings at www.gyes.com

Name: Algreen B.V.
Description:
Algreen is a company founded in 2015 in Wageningen, working all over Europe. We help microalgae producers in all aspects of their business: from production to downstream, regulation and certification. We combine hands on experience with scientific knowledge and skills to co-develop the algae production system tailored to your needs. 

Our mission is ‘every day algae’. We strongly believe in the potential of algae to become a large scale commodity, replacing many traditional products, thanks to their unique properties and their sustainable and scalable production methods.

Name: Mylium BV
Description:
We see fungi as our circular motor for fibre production. Through fungal growth we upcycle waste streams into biobased and plastic-free textiles.

Our scalable production technology enables the production of textiles with a consistent quality that are sold on roll in high volumes. Together with fashion brands, we aim to move away from the traditionally wasteful, linear production processes.

Name: VitroScan
Description:
VitroScan is a Dutch biotech company founded in 2016 and based at the Leiden Bio Science Park. We develop certified predictive ex vivo 3D tumor testing services for reliable treatment response prediction for the clinic and to improve patient stratification for clinical trials. Our proprietary technology provides highly reproducible drug testing in the native tumor microenvironment (TME).

VitroScan’s clinical trial program is performed in collaboration with expert clinicians from leading oncology centers. In these trials patient specific ex vivo tumor sensitivity to chemo-, targeted, or immunotherapy is correlated to clinical outcomes. 

We are dedicated to delivering predictive diagnostic testing to support better informed treatment decisions for cancer patients. 

Explore our website to learn more www.vitroscan.com

Name: LabMakelaar Benelux B.V.
Description:
Vision:
LabMakelaar Benelux strives for a world with a strong circular economy, in which companies have easy access to a total solution for the design and equipment of their laboratory with high quality and recycled material.

Mission:
LabMakelaar Benelux helps its clients to realise their projects with recycled products and quality material at relatively low pricing. We do this by collecting high-quality material in different ways in order to offer them in an attractive way via a central hub to companies requiring a laboratory, so they can be serviced by one central organisation.

LabMakelaar attaches great importance to:
- Products and materials being used again and therefore retain their value.
- Products that fully align with the demands and expectations of clients.
- Employees being able to create an open culture based on integrity, trust and respect.
- A constructive and pleasant way of collaboration, both internally as well as with external parties.
- Using opportunities that realise and organise more chain cooperation, use less raw materials and produce less waste.
- Materials not meeting the quality standards to be disposed of correctly in the chain, so that raw materials can be extracted again.

Name: Fuse Vectors
Description: At Fuse Vectors, our mission is to revolutionize AAV gene therapy development. Traditional cell-based technologies have hindered progress, posing challenges in safety, efficacy, development time, and cost. Our Cell-Free AAV technology surpasses these methods, producing safer, more effective, and cost-efficient AAV viral vectors in a fraction of the time.

Name: Okos Diagnostics
Description:
Okos Diagnostics, founded in 2022 and headquartered in Leiden, Netherlands, is a pioneering Medtech company revolutionizing the In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) sector by replacing petroleum-based plastics with fully
biodegradable materials. Spun out of a 2020 Covid test innovation, Okos has developed and patented the world's first 100% bio-based, biodegradable cassettes for lateral flow assays (LFAs), offering a scalable and
sustainable solution to the massive medical waste crisis generated by single-use diagnostics.

Now offering our own product line of eco-friendly rapid tests via www.measie.com

Name: VUS Genetics
Description:
VUS Genetics is building the gene variant-level functional data platform for targeted treatment in oncology and for rare genetic diseases. Through our proprietary geneSlice functional genomics platform — exclusively licensed from SickKids Hospital, Toronto — we generate drug response data at the individual gene variant level, giving biopharma the evidence they need to match the right patients to the right drugs.

We work in asset-focused partnerships with biotech and pharma companies across the full drug development value chain — from drug target validation to clinical trial design and label expansion. Our initial focus is DNA repair deficient cancers — including novel targeted therapies for PARPi resistant BRCA-mutated cancers — and we are now scaling across oncology indications and rare genetic diseases, where variant-level functional data is equally transformative.

Our platform generates clean, endogenous gene variant data with zero off-target noise — ideal for training and validating AI-driven clinical decision tools. We combine geneSlice cell models, partner clinical data, and AI-powered analysis to create the data infrastructure next-generation precision medicine requires.

We are an ambitious team based in Amsterdam and remote locations. If you are driven by mechanistic insight at the intersection of functional genomics, oncology, and rare disease — and want your work to reach patients — we would love to hear from you.

Name: Flindr Therapeutics
Description: Flindr Therapeutics, based in Oss in the Netherlands, is a private pre-clinical biotech company developing next-generation precision oncology treatments. The Company, previously called Immagene, was spun out of the Netherlands Cancer Institute (NKI) and Oncode Institute in 2020, by founders Prof Daniel Peeper, Prof Christian Blank and Dr Maarten Ligtenberg. Flindr is actively building a pipeline of highly promising, first-in-class precision oncology therapies identified through the ImmunoGram Drug Discovery Engine. It is backed by V-Bio Ventures, Johnson & Johnson Innovation – JJDC, Inc., QBIC Fund, Flanders Future Tech Fund, Curie Capital, Oncode Oncology Bridge Fund, Swanbridge, Innovatiefonds Noord Holland, and BOM. Flindr has entered into a research collaboration with the NKI, and the VIB (Flanders Institute of Biotechnology).

Name: Kynexis
Description:
Kynexis is advancing a potential first-in-class approach to restore cognitive function for people living with brain diseases.

The company is developing KYN-5356, a first-in-class KAT-II inhibitor designed to lower elevated kynurenic acid (KYNA), a key biological driver of cognitive impairment in disorders including schizophrenia and Alzheimer's disease. By targeting this novel pathway, KYN-5356 is designed to restore the signaling required for normal cognitive function.

KYN-5356 is currently being evaluated in a Phase 2 clinical trial for cognitive impairment associated with schizophrenia (CIAS), with development expanding into Alzheimer's disease.

At Kynexis, we are driven by a simple purpose: improving cognition to enable a better life for people with brain diseases.

Name: MAT Research
Description:
We have developed an improved Monocyte Activation Test (MAT) for pyrogen testing. The MAT serves as the replacement for the Rabbit Pyrogen Test and can be used to test parenteral drugs for endotoxin and non-endotoxin contaminations. Our technology uses cryopreserved pooled PBMC. This has made it possible to develop a MAT with both high sensitivity and robustness, ensuring reliability in the field.

Monocyte Activation Test (MAT)
The Monocyte Activation Test (MAT) is a pyrogen test. MAT uses human blood cells to test for a fever reaction, mimicking the human immune reaction.The MAT serves as the replacement for the Rabbit Pyrogen Test and can be used to test parenteral drugs for endotoxin and non-endotoxin contaminations. Our technology uses cryopreserved pooled PBMC. This has made it possible to develop a MAT with both high sensitivity and robustness, ensuring reliability in the field. The MAT kit includes all the required consumables to perform the Monocyte Activation Test, making it convenient to perform. In addition to the kit we provide consulting services and technical support in setting up the MAT in your organisation.

Name: CHV International
Description: CHV develops innovative and sustainable solutions to increase crops health and resilience leading to sustainable increase of yields. At CHV we develop products with the aim to reduce stress, increase quality and improve nutrient uptake and plant activity. Our mission is to develop natural products which are easy to use and have reproducible and measurable effects.

Name: MeiraGTx Netherlands B.V.
Description: MeiraGTx Netherlands B.V. is an Amsterdam based biopharmaceutical company developing local gene therapy for different indications. The company specializes in the development of viral gene therapy vectors, in particular adeno-associated virus (AAV) based therapeutics. Our goal is to develop potentially curative treatments for patients living with serious diseases. Several product candidates are in the discovery and development phase. Meira GTx Netherlands B.V. is a wholly-owned subsidiary of MeiraGTx Holdings plc. With sites in New York, London, Shannon and Amsterdam, our global footprint provides us the opportunity to partner with leading institutions around the world, allowing us to deepen our understanding of diseases and their progression.

Name: biotactical
Description:
biotactical is incubated on the Leiden Bio Science Park eco-system surrounded with innovative therapies and life sciences & health solutions with access to established pharmaceutical companies and network.

From R&D to GMP production of our regulatory-aligned Rapid Microbial Method testkit and manufacturing of our instrument is done in-house. We have successfully reduced the current waiting time of 14 days to a consistent 48 hours for any pharmaceutical product from vaccines to ATMPs. 

With our platform technology we are able to provide help with AMR focused products and providing reliable data. 

Additionally, we guide and train our clients regarding their Pandemic Preparedness manufacturing strategy for life-saving pharmaceutical products, releasing them faster to the market and increasing production aligned with PDA TR33, USP<1223>, Ph. Eur. 5.1.6, USP<71>, USP<73> and JP 4.06.

Name: Amusca B.V.-All About Insects
Description:
Amusca enables companies worldwide to convert residual flows such as organic pulp and manure with insect larvae into biocompost and larvae consisting of a maximum of 30% fat and 65% protein in just three days using our innovative insect technology and services.
Website: www.amusca.com
e-mail: walterjansen@amusca.com

Name: Utrecht Holdings
Description: Binnen Universiteit Utrecht en UMC Utrecht wordt veel medische en wetenschappelijke kennis ontwikkeld die beschermd moet en geexploiteerd kan worden. Hiervoor zijn UU Holding BV en UMC Utrecht Holding BV opgericht. Zij werken samen in Utrecht Holdings. Utrecht Holdings beheert en exploiteert octrooien voor Universiteit Utrecht en UMC Utrecht. Daarnaast begeleidt en ondersteunt de organisatie ondernemende medewerkers en/of de initiatiefnemers van nieuwe spin off bedrijven tot ze op eigen benen kunnen staan. Hoe succesvol we hierin zijn, en welke projecten we realiseren, is te zien op onze website utrechtholdings.nl

Name: Duplaco B.V.
Description: Duplaco, based in the Netherlands, reinvented farming to grow clean and rich Chlorella microalgae in a 100% closed system, without disturbing nature. These microalgae are packed with protein, fibers, vitamins, minerals and antioxidants. Big impact, tiny footprint.

Name: OurCelia
Description:
For the Klerken family, OurCelia is more than a new company — it is a bold step to shape the future of
the mushroom industry. With deep roots that stretch back generations, the family has always believed in the
power of mushrooms to nourish people and transform industries. OurCelia will build on that legacy by
reimagining spawn and substrate production for a new era, delivering cutting-edge solutions that help
mushroom farmers grow stronger businesses, diversify their crops, and expand into new markets. By
combining tradition with forward-looking innovation, the Klerken family aims to make OurCelia a global leader
in advancing fungi as a cornerstone of sustainable food, agriculture, and materials for decades to come.

About OurCelia
OurCelia is a Dutch producer of high-quality mushroom spawn and substrates, rooted in decades of expertise
within the global mushroom industry. Founded in 2025 following the acquisition of Ecovative Spawn &
Substrate BV by the Klerken family, also founders of Scelta Mushrooms, the company builds on a long
heritage of innovation and entrepreneurship in mushroom cultivation. By combining tradition with cutting-edge
technologies, OurCelia supports growers worldwide with reliable, sustainable solutions that strengthen their
businesses and open new opportunities for the future.

Name: LIPOSOMA
Description:
LIPOSOMA is a science-driven company specialized in lipid-based delivery systems for pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals, medical nutrition, and immunological research.

Founded in 2014 to commercialize liposomal clodronate for immunological research, LIPOSOMA has since evolved into a dynamic group of companies, driving innovation in human health.

Today, the LIPOSOMA group consists of:

Liposoma BV; our original entity, dedicated to supporting immunological research through clodronate liposomes.

Liposoma Health BV; our innovation hub (est. 2019), focused on developing and commercializing advanced lipid-based delivery systems for nutritional, pharmaceutical, and medical applications.

Together, we deliver science-backed solutions that improve the bioavailability, stability, and efficacy of active compounds.

Name: BioSB
Description: BioSB is the national community for bioinformatics and systems biology research and innovation in the Netherlands. We connect researchers, PhD candidates, students, educators, and industry partners to accelerate impact and scientific innovation, enable collaboration, and provide postgraduate training.

Name: ExoVectory
Description: www.exovectory.com

Name: DDL Diagnostic Laboratory
Description:
Stripes earned
DDL is known for its state-of-the-art expertise of design, development, validation and application of diagnostic methods for human diagnostics. Not only are we recognized by pharmaceutical companies, hospitals, diagnostic laboratories and key opinion leaders as a top-quality diagnostic service & development company; we are also valued as a reliable business partner that provides superior service.

Our employees
We are proud of our employees and they are proud of us. To us it is simple: our employees are the most important part of our company. We are fully aware of the fact that they are key to our success and delivering the top quality our customers’ have come to know and love. Our employees are highly motivated, flexible and they enjoy working in a challenging and dynamic environment where teamwork is essential. We offer a good benefits package and additional perks. 

Growth, impact and fun! 
At DDL we focus on the three pillars Growth, Impact and Fun. That is why we offer all of our employees the opportunity to grow, develop and become a specialist in their field of expertise. That way they can continue to make an important impact on healthcare with their top-quality contribution. And because we all know that happy employees achieve most, we offer them a fun, positive and dynamic environment, where work, happiness and health are well-balanced.

If you happen to share our passion for quality, complexity, science, teamwork, having fun and making the world a healthier place, DDL is the right employer for YOU!

Name: Predica Diagnostics BV
Description:
Patients should only undergo medical procedures that are meaningful and necessary. No woman should have unjustified worries about getting cervical cancer and every cancer patient is taken care off with effective treatment protocols only. 

Our first product, the CervicaDx test, will prevent overdiagnosis and overtreatment of women, participating in cervical cancer screening programs, by detecting cervical aberrations before they can develop into cancer, with much higher specificity than is currently feasible.

Name: ExCulture
Description: Developing an animal-free heparin alternative from bio-based secondary feedstocks.

Name: MagtivioTM
Description: At Magtivio B.V. we accelerate life science innovation with premium magnetic micro- and nanoparticles and ready-to-use sample preparation kits, designed to make your research and diagnostic workflows faster, cleaner, and more consistent.

Name: EGGXPERT
Description:
Transforming waste into value for a circular future.
EGGXPERT upcycles eggshell biowaste into sustainable, high-value materials and protein ingredients. With WonderLimeTM and WonderCareTM, we create circular solutions for industrial, nutrition, wellness, and personal care applications.

Our products replace conventional materials with bio-based, circular alternatives that perform better and impact less. 

We believe that the materials of tomorrow can come from the waste of today. By upcycling discarded eggshells and membranes into high-value minerals and proteins, we create ingredients that help industries reduce waste, improve performance, and move toward a circular future.

Name: Outlander Materials
Description:
Our unique material is vastly applicable across different industries, though we believe the greatest value to society comes from pursuing applications within packaging and horticulture.

Prime examples are; single use films for candy wrappers, fruits, and vegetables.
Our packaging solutions don’t follow the traditional set of rules. Instead we create packaging that can easily match our packaging needs while elevating the standard in life cycle design. From beginning to end, Outlander Materials reduce waste, can be produced locally, and cause no harm at the end of their very useful lives. 
A circular solution that leaves nothing behind except a beautiful legacy.

Name: Sapreme Therapeutics BV
Description: Sapreme is a preclinical-stage biotech company developing next-generation RNA therapeutics for patients with genetically driven diseases. Our proprietary endosomal escape technology enables targeted delivery of large molecules such as ASOs and siRNAs to intracellular targets in liver and extrahepatic tissues.

Name: Bionomic
Description:
Bionomic is een startup binnen de agrarische sector, gespecialiseerd in het verbeteren van de kwaliteit en duurzaamheid van gewassen. Wij richten ons op het bestrijden van pathogenen met geavanceerde moleculaire technieken. 

Onze expertise ligt in de ontwikkeling van PCR-gebaseerde detectie voor vroegtijdige identificatie van infecties en de ontwikkeling van nieuwe gewasbeschermingsmiddelen.

Name: Mérieux NutriSciences | Nederland
Description: Als onderdeel van Institut Mérieux heeft Mérieux NutriSciences zich ten doel gesteld om de gezondheid van consumenten wereldwijd te beschermen. Dit wordt gegarandeerd door een breed spectrum van analyses en advies aan te bieden aan industrieën die gerelateerd zijn aan voedsel en voeding, agrochemicaliën, en farmaceutisch en cosmetische producten. Met meer dan 50 jaar ervaring in voedselveiligheid en -kwaliteit, en een uitgebreide aanwezigheid in 21 landen met meer dan 100 geaccrediteerde laboratoria, heeft Mérieux NutriSciences zich gemanifesteerd als een van de leiders in deze markt.

Name: CryoSol-World
Description: CryoSol-World (CryoSol) is an innovative high-tech company that aims to become the global leader in sample preparation technology for cryo-EM. Name: IGEM Amsterdam 2020 "Forbidden FRUITS"
Description:
We are iGEM (The International Genetically Engineered Machine competition) 2020 Amsterdam team. We’re challenging the current limitations of biotechnology. 

Our solution: We are identifying points in microbial metabolic networks that can be leveraged to couple biotechnological production to microbial growth. This means that microbes are incentivized to keep producing products of interest because it is necessary for their own growth.
      To accomplish this, we are modifying the existing FRUITS algorithm, which
identifies opportunities for growth-coupled production within the metabolic network of a host organism. Traditionally, this algorithm has been limited to native metabolic products, but with our introduction of “Forbidden FRUITS” we will expand this tool to allow for the production of non-native metabolites, products that are not naturally made by a host microbe, and therefore ‘forbidden’, due to technological limitations. This conceptually means that we are expanding the variety of what we can produce, independent of which microbe is producing it. Salicylic acid made by E. coli? We are on it.

Description:

CuroTis is an innovative StartUp that aims to lead the development of the next generation of body-own regenerative medicine and has therefore developed the XSGraft.

Renal and vascular diseases are among the leading causes of death worldwide and maintaining vascular access is critical to the for survival of patients suffering from these conditions. However, almost daily cannulations damage the patient’s blood vessels, and eventually even synthetic grafts can no longer be used to provide vascular access.
A key challenge in vascular graft development is to create a graft that closely mimics the natural properties of human blood vessels. 

The XSGraft is an implant which stimulates the body to grow vascular tissue at the target site that can be used for various applications. The initial application is in the cardiovascular field where the created tissue in the shape of a tube is grafted in the vasculature. site. Within four weeks post-grafting, a new, disease-free blood vessel forms, endowed with elastin and a functional endothelial layer. With this solution patients requiring vascular access e.g. for injections or dialysis treatment will obtain a regenerative, body-own vascular graft.

CuroTis is the tradename of VACIS B.V.

Description:

With more than $200B being invested in global biologics manufacturing capacity, the industry faces a critical need for purification infrastructure that can support both today’s high-volume IgG antibodies and next-generation formats, including IgA, IgM, Fc-fusion proteins, and other complex biologics.

APPCTM is designed to operate at neutral pH, simplify downstream workflows, and support faster, gentler, and more cost-effective purification across established and emerging antibody formats.

With patent protection in multiple regions and validation by industry partners, AromAb is advancing toward pilot-scale development and engaging with investors, biopharma companies, CDMOs, and strategic partners.
